text: Ān on-ginn is ealra þinga, þæt is God æl-mihtig.
text_bare: An on-ginn is ealra þinga, þæt is God æl-mihtig.

text: Se gelēafa þe biþ būtan gōdum weorcum, sē is dēad; þis sind þāra apostola word.
text_bare: Se geleafa þe biþ butan godum weorcum, se is dead; þis sind þara apostola word.

text: Ic eom gōd hierde: se gōda hierde selþ his āgen līf for his scēapum.
text_bare: Ic eom god hierde: se goda hierde selþ his agen lif for his sceapum.

text: Ūre Ālīesend is se gōda hierde, and wē crīstene menn sind his sceap.
text_bare: Ure Aliesend is se goda hierde, and we cristene menn sind his sceap.

text: Se mōna his leoht ne selþ, and steorran of heofone feallaþ.
text_bare: Se mona his leoht ne selþ, and steorran of heofone feallaþ.

text: Swā swā wæter ādwǣscþ fȳr, swā ādwǣscþ sēo ælmesse synna.
text_bare: Swa swa wæter adwæscþ fyr, swa adwæscþ seo ælmesse synna.

text: Ealle gesceafta, heofonas and englas, sunnan and mōnan, steorran and eorþan, eall nīetenu and ealle fuglas, sǣ and ealle fiscas God gescōp and geworhte on siex dagum; and on þǣm seofoþan dæge hē geendode his weorc; and hē behēold þā eall his weorc þe hē geworhte, and hīe wǣron eall swīþe gōd.
text_bare: Ealle gesceafta, heofonas and englas, sunnan and monan, steorran and eorþan, eall nietenu and ealle fuglas, sæ and ealle fiscas God gescop and geworhte on siex dagum; and on þæm seofoþan dæge he geendode his weorc; and he beheold þa eall his weorc þe he geworhte, and hie wæron eall swiþe god.

text: Hē fērde geond manigu land, bodiende Godes gelēafan.
text_bare: He ferde geond manigu land, bodiende Godes geleafan.

text: Hē forlēt eall woruld-þing.
text_bare: He forlet eall woruld-þing.

text: Se cyning bebēad þæt man scolde ofer eall Angel-cynn scipu wyrcan; and hiera wæs swā fela swā nǣfre ǣr ne wæs on nānes cyninges dæge.
text_bare: Se cyning bebead þæt man scolde ofer eall Angel-cynn scipu wyrcan; and hiera wæs swa fela swa næfre ær ne wæs on nanes cyninges dæge.

text: Se cyning hēt ofslēan ealle þā Deniscan menn þe on Angel-cynne wǣron.
text_bare: Se cyning het ofslean ealle þa Deniscan menn þe on Angel-cynne wæron.

text: Þā ne mihton hīe him nān word and-swarian, ne nān mann ne dorste hine nān þing māre āscian.
text_bare: Þa ne mihton hie him nan word and-swarian, ne nan mann ne dorste hine nan þing mare ascian.

text: Hīe fuhton on þā burg ealne dæg, and þōhton þæt hīe hīe scolden ābrecan.
text_bare: Hie fuhton on þa burg ealne dæg, and þohton þæt hie hie scolden abrecan.

text: Se eorl gewende west tō Īr-lande, and wæs þǣr ealne þone winter.
text_bare: Se eorl gewende west to Ir-lande, and wæs þær ealne þone winter.

text: Æþelred cyning and Ælfred his brōþor fuhton wiþ ealne þone here on Æsces-dūne.
text_bare: Æþelred cyning and Ælfred his broþor fuhton wiþ ealne þone here on Æsces-dune.

text: Se mann is ēce on ānum dǣle, þæt is, on þǣre sāwle; hēo ne geendaþ nǣfre.
text_bare: Se mann is ece on anum dæle, þæt is, on þære sawle; heo ne geendaþ næfre.

text: Gif se biscop dēþ be his āgnum willan, and wile bindan þone un-scyldigan, and þone scyldigan ālīesan, þonne forlīest hē þā miht þe him God forgeaf.
text_bare: Gif se biscop deþ be his agnum willan, and wile bindan þone un-scyldigan, and þone scyldigan aliesan, þonne forliest he þa miht þe him God forgeaf.

text: Þēod winþ ongēan þēode, and rīce ongēan rīce.
text_bare: Þeod winþ ongean þeode, and rice ongean rice.

text: Ealle menn ēow hatiaþ for mīnum naman.
text_bare: Ealle menn eow hatiaþ for minum naman.

text: Hē geworhte fela wundra binnan þǣm fierste þe hē biscop wæs.
text_bare: He geworhte fela wundra binnan þæm fierste þe he biscop wæs.

text: Hē gehǣlde sum wīf mid hālgum wætre.
text_bare: He gehælde sum wif mid halgum wætre.

text: Se cyning wearþ ofslægen fram his āgnum folce.
text_bare: Se cyning wearþ ofslægen fram his agnum folce.

text: On þǣm ilcan gēare wæs se micla hungor geond Angel-cynn.
text_bare: On þæm ilcan geare wæs se micla hungor geond Angel-cynn.

text: Se mæsse-prēost āscaþ þæt cild, and cwiþþ: 'Wiþsæcst þū dēofle?' Þonne andwyrt se god-fæder, and cwiþþ: 'Ic wiþsace dēofle.' God ælmihtiga, gemiltsa mē synn-fullum!
text_bare: Se mæsse-preost ascaþ þæt cild, and cwiþþ: 'Wiþsæcst þu deofle?' Þonne andwyrt se god-fæder, and cwiþþ: 'Ic wiþsace deofle.' God ælmihtiga, gemiltsa me synn-fullum!

text: Æþelred cyning cōm hām tō his āgenre þēode, and hē glædlīce fram him eallum onfangen wearþ.
text_bare: Æþelred cyning com ham to his agenre þeode, and he glædlice fram him eallum onfangen wearþ.

text: Crīst, ūre Dryhten, bebēad his leornung-cnihtum þæt hīe scolden tǣcan eallum þēodum þā þing þā hē self him tǣhte.
text_bare: Crist, ure Dryhten, bebead his leornung-cnihtum þæt hie scolden tæcan eallum þeodum þa þing þa he self him tæhte.

text: Gif gē forgiefaþ mannum hiera synna, þonne forgiefþ ēower se heofonlica Fæder ēowre synna.
text_bare: Gif ge forgiefaþ mannum hiera synna, þonne forgiefþ eower se heofonlica Fæder eowre synna.

text: Ne mæg nān mann twǣm hlāfordum þēowian: oþþe hē ānne hataþ and ōþerne lufaþ, oþþe hē biþ ānum gehīersum and ōþrum ungehīersum.
text_bare: Ne mæg nan mann twæm hlafordum þeowian: oþþe he anne hataþ and oþerne lufaþ, oþþe he biþ anum gehiersum and oþrum ungehiersum.

text: Se cyning nam þæs eorles sunu mid him tō Engla-lande.
text_bare: Se cyning nam þæs eorles sunu mid him to Engla-lande.

text: Menn behōfiaþ gōdre lāre on þissum tīman, þe is geendung þisse worulde.
text_bare: Menn behofiaþ godre lare on þissum timan, þe is geendung þisse worulde.

text: Se līchama, þe is þǣre sāwle rēaf, andbīdaþ þæs miclan dōmes; and þēah hē bēo tō dūste formolsnod, God hine ārǣrþ, and gebringþ tōgædre sāwle and līchaman tō þǣm ēcan līfe.
text_bare: Se lichama, þe is þære sawle reaf, andbidaþ þæs miclan domes; and þeah he beo to duste formolsnod, God hine arærþ, and gebringþ togædre sawle and lichaman to þæm ecan life.

text: Hwelc fæder wile sellan his cilde stān, gif hit hine hlāfes bitt?
text_bare: Hwelc fæder wile sellan his cilde stan, gif hit hine hlafes bitt?

text: Āgiefaþ þǣm cāsere þā þing þe þæs cāseres sind, and Gode þā þing þe Godes sind.
text_bare: Agiefaþ þæm casere þa þing þe þæs caseres sind, and Gode þa þing þe Godes sind.

text: Sēo sāwol and-bīdaþ þæs ēcan ǣristes.
text_bare: Seo sawol and-bidaþ þæs ecan æristes.

text: Hē wæs cyning ofer eall Engla-land twentig wintra.
text_bare: He wæs cyning ofer eall Engla-land twentig wintra.

text: God ælmihtig is ealra cyninga cyning, and ealra hlāforda hlāford.
text_bare: God ælmihtig is ealra cyninga cyning, and ealra hlaforda hlaford.

text: Dēofol is ealra un-riht-wīsra manna hēafod, and þā yflan menn sind his limu.
text_bare: Deofol is ealra un-riht-wisra manna heafod, and þa yflan menn sind his limu.

text: Synnfulra manna dēaþ is yfel and earmlic, for þǣm þe hīe faraþ of þissum scortan līfe tō ēcum wītum.
text_bare: Synnfulra manna deaþ is yfel and earmlic, for þæm þe hie faraþ of þissum scortan life to ecum witum.

text: Hū fela hlāfa hæbbe gē?
text_bare: Hu fela hlafa hæbbe ge?

text: Seofon, and fēa fisca.
text_bare: Seofon, and fea fisca.

text: Ne gewilna þū ōþres mannes ǣhta!
text_bare: Ne gewilna þu oþres mannes æhta!

text: On þǣm landum eardodon Engle, ǣr þǣm þe hīe hider on land cōmon.
text_bare: On þæm landum eardodon Engle, ær þæm þe hie hider on land comon.

text: Hīe fuhton on þā burg ealne dæg, ac hīe ne mihton hīe ābrecan.
text_bare: Hie fuhton on þa burg ealne dæg, ac hie ne mihton hie abrecan.

text: Þā ēodon hīe tō hiera scipum.
text_bare: Þa eodon hie to hiera scipum.

text: Þǣr bēoþ swīþe manige byrig on þǣm lande, and on ǣlcre byrig biþ cyning.
text_bare: Þær beoþ swiþe manige byrig on þæm lande, and on ælcre byrig biþ cyning.

text: God cwæþ tō Noē: 'Ic wile fordōn eall mann-cynn mid wætre for hiera synnum, ac ic wile gehealdan þē, and þīn wīf, and þīne þrīe suna.' Ān mann hæfde twēgen suna; þā cwæþ hē tō þǣm ieldran: 'gā and wyrc tōdæg on mīnum wīn-gearde.' Þā cwæþ hē: 'ic nyle:' ēode þēah siþþan tō þǣm wīngearde.
text_bare: God cwæþ to Noe: 'Ic wile fordon eall mann-cynn mid wætre for hiera synnum, ac ic wile gehealdan þe, and þin wif, and þine þrie suna.' An mann hæfde twegen suna; þa cwæþ he to þæm ieldran: 'ga and wyrc todæg on minum win-gearde.' Þa cwæþ he: 'ic nyle:' eode þeah siþþan to þæm wingearde.

text: Hē dyde his fæder willan.
text_bare: He dyde his fæder willan.

text: Se prēost cwæþ tō þǣm folce: 'Ic ēow blētsige on naman þæs Fæder, þæs Suna, and þæs Hālgan Gāstes.' Āra þīnum fæder and þīnre mēder!
text_bare: Se preost cwæþ to þæm folce: 'Ic eow bletsige on naman þæs Fæder, þæs Suna, and þæs Halgan Gastes.' Ara þinum fæder and þinre meder!

text: Sum wīf cōm tō Crīste, and bæd for hiere dehter.
text_bare: Sum wif com to Criste, and bæd for hiere dehter.

text: Sēo dohtor wearþ gehǣled þurh gelēafan þǣre mōdor.
text_bare: Seo dohtor wearþ gehæled þurh geleafan þære modor.

text: Bēoþ gemyndige þāra twēgra worda þe Dryhten cwæþ on his god-spelle!
text_bare: Beoþ gemyndige þara twegra worda þe Dryhten cwæþ on his god-spelle!

text: Hē cwæþ: 'Forgiefaþ, and ēow biþ forgiefen; sellaþ, and ēow biþ geseald.' Twēgen menn ēodon intō Godes temple hīe tō gebiddenne.
text_bare: He cwæþ: 'Forgiefaþ, and eow biþ forgiefen; sellaþ, and eow biþ geseald.' Twegen menn eodon into Godes temple hie to gebiddenne.

text: Ælfred cyning fōr mid þrim scipum ūt on sǣ, and gefeaht wiþ fēower scip-hlæstas Deniscra manna, and þāra scipa twā genam, and þā menn ofslægene wǣron þe þǣr-on wǣron.
text_bare: Ælfred cyning for mid þrim scipum ut on sæ, and gefeaht wiþ feower scip-hlæstas Deniscra manna, and þara scipa twa genam, and þa menn ofslægene wæron þe þær-on wæron.

text: Þā cōmon þrēo scipu.
text_bare: Þa comon þreo scipu.

text: Þā gefēngon hīe þāra þrēora scipa twā, and þā menn ofslōgon, ealle būtan fīfum.
text_bare: Þa gefengon hie þara þreora scipa twa, and þa menn ofslogon, ealle butan fifum.

text: Se wītega āwrāt be þǣm fēower nīetenum þe him ætīewdu wǣron, þæt hīe hæfden ēagan him on ǣlce healfe.
text_bare: Se witega awrat be þæm feower nietenum þe him ætiewdu wæron, þæt hie hæfden eagan him on ælce healfe.

text: Ān þāra nīetena wæs on menniscre onsīene him ætīewed, ōþer on lēon onsīene, þridde on cealfes, fēorþe on earnes.
text_bare: An þara nietena wæs on menniscre onsiene him ætiewed, oþer on leon onsiene, þridde on cealfes, feorþe on earnes.

text: God þone ǣrestan mann rihtne and gōdne gescōp, and eall mann-cynn mid him.
text_bare: God þone ærestan mann rihtne and godne gescop, and eall mann-cynn mid him.

text: Ælfred Æþelwulfing wæs cyning ofer eall Angel-cynn būtan þǣm dǣle þe under Dena onwealde wæs.
text_bare: Ælfred Æþelwulfing wæs cyning ofer eall Angel-cynn butan þæm dæle þe under Dena onwealde wæs.

text: Ǣlc gōd trēow bierþ gōde wæstmas, and ǣlc yfel trēow bierþ yfle wæstmas; ne mæg þæt gōde trēow beran yfle wæstmas, ne þæt yfle trēow gōde wæstmas.
text_bare: Ælc god treow bierþ gode wæstmas, and ælc yfel treow bierþ yfle wæstmas; ne mæg þæt gode treow beran yfle wæstmas, ne þæt yfle treow gode wæstmas.

text: Ēadigu sind ēowru ēagan, for þǣm þe hīe gesēoþ, and ēowru ēaran, for þǣm þe hīe gehīeraþ.
text_bare: Eadigu sind eowru eagan, for þæm þe hie geseoþ, and eowru earan, for þæm þe hie gehieraþ.

text: Swā hwā swā selþ ānum þurstigum menn ceald wæter on mīnum naman, ne forlīest hē his mēde.
text_bare: Swa hwa swa selþ anum þurstigum menn ceald wæter on minum naman, ne forliest he his mede.

text: Ne fare gē on hǣþenra manna wege!
text_bare: Ne fare ge on hæþenra manna wege!

text: Gōd mann of gōdum gold-horde bringþ gōd forþ; and yfel mann of yflum goldhorde bringþ yfel forþ.
text_bare: God mann of godum gold-horde bringþ god forþ; and yfel mann of yflum goldhorde bringþ yfel forþ.

text: Gregōrius se hālga pāpa is rihtlīce gecweden Engliscre þēode apostol.
text_bare: Gregorius se halga papa is rihtlice gecweden Engliscre þeode apostol.

text: Þā hē geseah þæt se mǣsta dǣl þǣre þēode his lāre forsāwon, þā forlēt hē hīe, and gecēas þā hǣþnan lēode.
text_bare: Þa he geseah þæt se mæsta dæl þære þeode his lare forsawon, þa forlet he hie, and geceas þa hæþnan leode.

text: Gif se blinda blindne lǣtt, hīe feallaþ bēgen on ānne pytt.
text_bare: Gif se blinda blindne lætt, hie feallaþ begen on anne pytt.

text: Se Hālga Gāst is lufu and willa þæs Fæder and þæs Suna; and hīe sind ealle gelīce mihtige.
text_bare: Se Halga Gast is lufu and willa þæs Fæder and þæs Suna; and hie sind ealle gelice mihtige.

text: Betere is sēo sāwol þonne se mete, and betera se līchama þonne his scrūd.
text_bare: Betere is seo sawol þonne se mete, and betera se lichama þonne his scrud.

text: Sēo sāwol is gāst, and be eorþlicum mettum ne leofaþ.
text_bare: Seo sawol is gast, and be eorþlicum mettum ne leofaþ.

text: Behealdaþ þās flēogendan fuglas, þe ne sāwaþ ne ne rīpaþ, ac se heofonlica Fæder hīe āfētt.
text_bare: Behealdaþ þas fleogendan fuglas, þe ne sawaþ ne ne ripaþ, ac se heofonlica Fæder hie afett.

text: Hē cwæþ, 'Ic neom ōþrum mannum gelīc;' swelce hē cwǣde, 'Ic āna eom rihtwīs, and þā ōþre sind synn-fulle.' Þā se Hǣlend þanon fōr, þā folgodon him twēgen blinde, cweþende: 'Gemiltsa unc, Davīdes sunu!' Hē cwæþ tō him: 'Gelīefe git þæt ic inc mæge gehælan?' Hē cwæþ: 'Sīe inc æfter incrum gelēafan.' Æþelstān cyning fōr inn on Scot-land, ǣgþer ge mid land-here ge mid scip-here, and his micel oferhergode.
text_bare: He cwæþ, 'Ic neom oþrum mannum gelic;' swelce he cwæde, 'Ic ana eom rihtwis, and þa oþre sind synn-fulle.' Þa se Hælend þanon for, þa folgodon him twegen blinde, cweþende: 'Gemiltsa unc, Davides sunu!' He cwæþ to him: 'Geliefe git þæt ic inc mæge gehælan?' He cwæþ: 'Sie inc æfter incrum geleafan.' Æþelstan cyning for inn on Scot-land, ægþer ge mid land-here ge mid scip-here, and his micel oferhergode.

text: Se mann þe God forgiett, God forgiett ēac hine.
text_bare: Se mann þe God forgiett, God forgiett eac hine.

text: Faraþ, and lǣraþ ealle þēoda!
text_bare: Faraþ, and læraþ ealle þeoda!

text: Lǣraþ hīe þæt hīe healden eall þā þing þe ic ēow bebēad!
text_bare: Læraþ hie þæt hie healden eall þa þing þe ic eow bebead!

text: Sume menn sægdon be him þæt hē wǣre Ælfredes sunu cyninges.
text_bare: Sume menn sægdon be him þæt he wære Ælfredes sunu cyninges.

text: Se Hǣlend āscode his leornung-cnihtas, 'Hwone secgaþ menn þæt sīe mannes Sunu?' Hwæt secge gē þæt ic sīe?
text_bare: Se Hælend ascode his leornung-cnihtas, 'Hwone secgaþ menn þæt sie mannes Sunu?' Hwæt secge ge þæt ic sie?

text: Þū eart þæs libbendan Godes sunu.
text_bare: Þu eart þæs libbendan Godes sunu.

text: Crīst cwæþ be his Fæder: 'Gē secgaþ þæt hē ēower God sīe, and gē hine ne oncnēowon.' Gif hīe þone hālgan Fæder oncnēowen, þonne underfēngen hīe mid gelēafan his Sunu, þe hē āsende tō middan-gearde.
text_bare: Crist cwæþ be his Fæder: 'Ge secgaþ þæt he eower God sie, and ge hine ne oncneowon.' Gif hie þone halgan Fæder oncneowen, þonne underfengen hie mid geleafan his Sunu, þe he asende to middan-gearde.

text: Se weg is swīþe nearu and sticol sē þe lǣtt tō heofona rīce; and se weg is swīþe brād and smēþe sē þe lǣtt tō helle wite.
text_bare: Se weg is swiþe nearu and sticol se þe lætt to heofona rice; and se weg is swiþe brad and smeþe se þe lætt to helle wite.

text: Dysig biþ se weg-fērenda mann sē þe nimþ þone smēþan weg þe hīne mis-lǣtt, and forlǣtt þone sticolan þe hine gebringþ tō þǣre byrig.
text_bare: Dysig biþ se weg-ferenda mann se þe nimþ þone smeþan weg þe hine mis-lætt, and forlætt þone sticolan þe hine gebringþ to þære byrig.

text: Þæt ic ēow secge on þēostrum, secgaþ hit on leohte; and þæt gē on ēare gehīeraþ, bodiaþ uppan hrōfum.
text_bare: Þæt ic eow secge on þeostrum, secgaþ hit on leohte; and þæt ge on eare gehieraþ, bodiaþ uppan hrofum.

text: Hīe scufon ūt hiera scipu, and gewendon him begeondan sǣ.
text_bare: Hie scufon ut hiera scipu, and gewendon him begeondan sæ.

text: Healdaþ and dōþ swā hwæt swā hīe secgaþ; and ne dō gē nā, æfter hiera weorcum: hīe secgaþ, and ne dōþ.
text_bare: Healdaþ and doþ swa hwæt swa hie secgaþ; and ne do ge na, æfter hiera weorcum: hie secgaþ, and ne doþ.

text: Eall hiera weorc hīe dōþ þæt menn hīe gesēon.
text_bare: Eall hiera weorc hie doþ þæt menn hie geseon.

text: Hīe lufiaþ þæt man hīe grēte on strǣtum.
text_bare: Hie lufiaþ þæt man hie grete on strætum.

text: Wē sind ealle cuman on þissum and-weardan līfe, and ūre eard nis nā hēr; ac wē sind hēr swelce weg-fērende menn: ān cymþ, ōþer færþ.
text_bare: We sind ealle cuman on þissum and-weardan life, and ure eard nis na her; ac we sind her swelce weg-ferende menn: an cymþ, oþer færþ.

text: Hwelc mann selþ his bearne nǣddran, gif hit fisces bitt?
text_bare: Hwelc mann selþ his bearne næddran, gif hit fisces bitt?

text: Ǣlc þāra þe bitt, hē onfēhþ; and sē þe sēcþ, hē hit fint.
text_bare: Ælc þara þe bitt, he onfehþ; and se þe secþ, he hit fint.

text: Ne gǣþ ǣlc þāra on heofona rīce þe cwiþþ tō mē, 'Dryhten, Dryhten;' ac sē þe wyrcþ mīnes Fæder willan þe on heofonum is, sē gǣþ on heofona rīce.
text_bare: Ne gæþ ælc þara on heofona rice þe cwiþþ to me, 'Dryhten, Dryhten;' ac se þe wyrcþ mines Fæder willan þe on heofonum is, se gæþ on heofona rice.

text: Ic hæbbe þegnas under mē: and ic cweþe tō þissum, 'gā,' and hē gǣþ; and tō ōþrum, 'cum,' and hē cymþ, and tō mīnum þēowe, 'wyrc þis,' and hē wyrcþ.
text_bare: Ic hæbbe þegnas under me: and ic cweþe to þissum, 'ga,' and he gæþ; and to oþrum, 'cum,' and he cymþ, and to minum þeowe, 'wyrc þis,' and he wyrcþ.

text: Se Hǣlend genam þā fīf hlāfas, and blētsode, and tōbræc, and tōdǣlde betwix þǣm sittendum; swā gelīce ēac þā fiscas tōdǣlde; and hīe ealle genōg hæfdon.
text_bare: Se Hælend genam þa fif hlafas, and bletsode, and tobræc, and todælde betwix þæm sittendum; swa gelice eac þa fiscas todælde; and hie ealle genog hæfdon.

text: Hīe cōmon tō him, and tō him gebǣdon, and þus cwǣdon: 'Sōþlīce þū eart Godes sunu.' Ne wēne gē þæt ic cōme sibbe on eorþan to sendenne: ne cōm ic sibbe tō sendenne, ac sweord.
text_bare: Hie comon to him, and to him gebædon, and þus cwædon: 'Soþlice þu eart Godes sunu.' Ne wene ge þæt ic come sibbe on eorþan to sendenne: ne com ic sibbe to sendenne, ac sweord.

text: Hē bebēad þæt hīe sǣten ofer þǣre eorþan.
text_bare: He bebead þæt hie sæten ofer þære eorþan.

text: Hē sægde þæt Norþ-manna land wǣre swīþe lang and swīþe smæl.
text_bare: He sægde þæt Norþ-manna land wære swiþe lang and swiþe smæl.

text: Hīe ealle on þone cyning wǣron feohtende, oþ þæt hīe hine ofslægenne hæfdon.
text_bare: Hie ealle on þone cyning wæron feohtende, oþ þæt hie hine ofslægenne hæfdon.

text: Ǣlc mann þe ōþre menn forsihþ biþ fram Gode forsewen.
text_bare: Ælc mann þe oþre menn forsihþ biþ fram Gode forsewen.

text: Sē þe ēaran hæbbe tō gehiērenne, gehīere.
text_bare: Se þe earan hæbbe to gehierenne, gehiere.

text: Gōd is ūs hēr tō bēonne.
text_bare: God is us her to beonne.

text: God cwæþ tō ānum wītegan, sē wæs Ionas gehāten: 'Far tō þǣre byrig, and boda þǣr þā word þe ic þē secge.' Lufiaþ ēowre fīend, and dōþ wel þǣm þe ēow yfel dōþ.
text_bare: God cwæþ to anum witegan, se wæs Ionas gehaten: 'Far to þære byrig, and boda þær þa word þe ic þe secge.' Lufiaþ eowre fiend, and doþ wel þæm þe eow yfel doþ.

text: Sē þe ne lufaþ his brōþor, þone þe hē gesihþ, hū mæg hē lufian God, þone þe hē ne gesihþ līcham-līce?
text_bare: Se þe ne lufaþ his broþor, þone þe he gesihþ, hu mæg he lufian God, þone þe he ne gesihþ licham-lice?

text: Sege ūs hwonne þās þing geweorþen, and hwelc tācen sīe þīnes tō-cymes and worulde geendunge.
text_bare: Sege us hwonne þas þing geweorþen, and hwelc tacen sie þines to-cymes and worulde geendunge.

text: Se Hǣlend cwæþ tō ānum his leornung-cnihta, sē wæs hāten Philippus: 'Mid hwǣm magon wē bycgan hlāf þissum folce?' Wel wiste Crīst hwæt hē dōn wolde, and hē wiste þæt Philippus þæt nyste.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæþ to anum his leornung-cnihta, se wæs haten Philippus: 'Mid hwæm magon we bycgan hlaf þissum folce?' Wel wiste Crist hwæt he don wolde, and he wiste þæt Philippus þæt nyste.

text: God mæg dōn eall þing; wē sculon wundrian his mihte, and ēac gelīefan.
text_bare: God mæg don eall þing; we sculon wundrian his mihte, and eac geliefan.

text: Crīst ārǣrde Lazarum of dēaþe, and cwæþ tō his leornung-cnihtum: 'Tōlīesaþ his bendas, þæt hē gān mæge.' God is ælmihtig, and mæg dōn eall þæt hē wile.
text_bare: Crist arærde Lazarum of deaþe, and cwæþ to his leornung-cnihtum: 'Toliesaþ his bendas, þæt he gan mæge.' God is ælmihtig, and mæg don eall þæt he wile.

text: Gē nyton on hwelcre tīde ēower hlāford cuman wile.
text_bare: Ge nyton on hwelcre tide eower hlaford cuman wile.

text: For þǣm bēo gē gearwe; for þǣm þe mannes Sunu wile cuman on þǣre tīde þe gē nyton.
text_bare: For þæm beo ge gearwe; for þæm þe mannes Sunu wile cuman on þære tide þe ge nyton.

text: Se Hǣlend cwæþ be his Fæder: 'Ic hine cann, and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, þonne bēo ic lēas, ēow gelīc.' Se dēofol cwæþ tō Crīste: 'Gif þū sīe Godes sunu, cweþ tō þissum stānum þæt hīe bēon āwende tō hlāfum.' Þā and-wyrde se Hǣlend, and cwæþ: 'Hit is āwriten, "ne leofaþ se mann nā be hlāfe ānum, ac leofaþ be eallum þǣm wordum þe gāþ of Godes mūþe."' Se Hǣlend cōm tō him, þǣr hīe wǣron gegadrode, and cwæþ: 'Sīe sibb betwix ēow; ic hit eom; ne bēo gē nā āfyrhte.' Fæder ūre, þū þe eart on heofonum, sīe þīn nama gehālgod.
text_bare: Se Hælend cwæþ be his Fæder: 'Ic hine cann, and gif ic secge þæt ic hine ne cunne, þonne beo ic leas, eow gelic.' Se deofol cwæþ to Criste: 'Gif þu sie Godes sunu, cweþ to þissum stanum þæt hie beon awende to hlafum.' Þa and-wyrde se Hælend, and cwæþ: 'Hit is awriten, "ne leofaþ se mann na be hlafe anum, ac leofaþ be eallum þæm wordum þe gaþ of Godes muþe."' Se Hælend com to him, þær hie wæron gegadrode, and cwæþ: 'Sie sibb betwix eow; ic hit eom; ne beo ge na afyrhte.' Fæder ure, þu þe eart on heofonum, sie þin nama gehalgod.

text: Wē syngodon, wē dydon un-rihtlīce; sele ūs forgiefnesse: hwæt sculon wē dōn?
text_bare: We syngodon, we dydon un-rihtlice; sele us forgiefnesse: hwæt sculon we don?

text: Ǣlc þāra þe þās mīn word gehīerþ, and þā wyrcþ, biþ gelīc þǣm wīsan were, sē his hūs ofer stān getimbrode.
text_bare: Ælc þara þe þas min word gehierþ, and þa wyrcþ, biþ gelic þæm wisan were, se his hus ofer stan getimbrode.

text: Þā cōm þǣr regen and micel flōd, and þǣr blēowon windas, and āhruron on þæt hūs, and hit nā ne fēoll: sōþlīce hit wæs ofer stān getimbrod.
text_bare: Þa com þær regen and micel flod, and þær bleowon windas, and ahruron on þæt hus, and hit na ne feoll: soþlice hit wæs ofer stan getimbrod.

text: And ǣlc þāra þe gehīerþ þās mīn word, and þā ne wyrcþ, sē biþ gelīc þǣm dysigan menn, þe getimbrode his hūs ofer sand-ceosol.
text_bare: And ælc þara þe gehierþ þas min word, and þa ne wyrcþ, se biþ gelic þæm dysigan menn, þe getimbrode his hus ofer sand-ceosol.

text: Þā rīnde hit, and þǣr cōm flōd, and blēowon windas, and āhruron on þǣt hūs, and þæt hūs fēoll; and his hryre wæs micel.
text_bare: Þa rinde hit, and þær com flod, and bleowon windas, and ahruron on þæt hus, and þæt hus feoll; and his hryre wæs micel.

text: Hēr is mīn cnapa, þone ic gecēas; mīn gecorena, on þǣm wel gelīcode mīnre sāwle: ic āsette mīnne gāst ofer hine, and dōm hē bodaþ þēodum.
text_bare: Her is min cnapa, þone ic geceas; min gecorena, on þæm wel gelicode minre sawle: ic asette minne gast ofer hine, and dom he bodaþ þeodum.

text: Ne flītt hē, ne hē ne hriemþ, ne nān mann ne gehīerþ his stefne on strǣtum.
text_bare: Ne flitt he, ne he ne hriemþ, ne nan mann ne gehierþ his stefne on strætum.

text: Tōcwīesed hrēod hē ne forbrīett, and smēocende fleax hē ne ādwǣscþ, ǣr þǣm þe hē āweorpe dōm tō sige.
text_bare: Tocwiesed hreod he ne forbriett, and smeocende fleax he ne adwæscþ, ær þæm þe he aweorpe dom to sige.

text: And on his naman þēoda gehyhtaþ.
text_bare: And on his naman þeoda gehyhtaþ.

text: Sōþlīce ūt ēode se sāwere his sǣd tō sāwenne.
text_bare: Soþlice ut eode se sawere his sæd to sawenne.

text: And þā þā hē sēow, sumu hīe fēollon wiþ weg, and fuglas cōmon and ǣton þā.
text_bare: And þa þa he seow, sumu hie feollon wiþ weg, and fuglas comon and æton þa.

text: Sōþlīce sumu fēollon on stǣnihte, þǣr hit næfde micle eorþan, and hrædlīce ūp sprungon, for þǣm þe hīe næfdon pǣre eorþan dīepan; sōþlīce, ūp sprungenre sunnan, hīe ādrūgodon and forscruncon, for þǣm þe hīe næfdon wyrtruman.
text_bare: Soþlice sumu feollon on stænihte, þær hit næfde micle eorþan, and hrædlice up sprungon, for þæm þe hie næfdon pære eorþan diepan; soþlice, up sprungenre sunnan, hie adrugodon and forscruncon, for þæm þe hie næfdon wyrtruman.

text: Sōþlīce sumu fēollon on þornas, and þā þornas wēoxon, and forþrysmdon þā.
text_bare: Soþlice sumu feollon on þornas, and þa þornas weoxon, and forþrysmdon þa.

text: Heofona rīce is geworden þǣm menn gelīc þe sēow gōd sǣd on his æcere.
text_bare: Heofona rice is geworden þæm menn gelic þe seow god sæd on his æcere.

text: Sōþlīce, þā þā menn slēpon, þā cōm his fēonda sum, and ofersēow hit mid coccele onmiddan þǣm hwǣte, and fērde þanon.
text_bare: Soþlice, þa þa menn slepon, þa com his feonda sum, and oferseow hit mid coccele onmiddan þæm hwæte, and ferde þanon.

text: hwanon hæfde hē coccel?' Þā cwæþ hē: 'þæt dyde unhold mann.' Þā cwǣdon þā þēowas: 'Wilt þū, wē gāþ and gadriaþ hīe?' Þā cwæp hē: 'Nese: þȳ lǣs gē þone hwǣte āwyrtwalien, þonne gē þone coccel gadriaþ.
text_bare: hwanon hæfde he coccel?' Þa cwæþ he: 'þæt dyde unhold mann.' Þa cwædon þa þeowas: 'Wilt þu, we gaþ and gadriaþ hie?' Þa cwæp he: 'Nese: þy læs ge þone hwæte awyrtwalien, þonne ge þone coccel gadriaþ.

text: Lǣtaþ ǣgþer weaxan oþ rīp-tīman; and on pǣm rīptīman ic secge þǣm rīperum: "gadriaþ ǣrest þone coccel, and bindaþ scēaf-mǣlum tō forbærnenne; and gadriaþ þone hwǣte intō mīnum berne."' .
text_bare: Lætaþ ægþer weaxan oþ rip-timan; and on pæm riptiman ic secge þæm riperum: "gadriaþ ærest þone coccel, and bindaþ sceaf-mælum to forbærnenne; and gadriaþ þone hwæte into minum berne."' .

text: Þone behȳtt se mann þe hine fint, and for his blisse gǣþ, and selþ eall þæt hē āh, and gebygþ þone æcer.
text_bare: Þone behytt se mann þe hine fint, and for his blisse gæþ, and selþ eall þæt he ah, and gebygþ þone æcer.

text: Eft is heofona rīce gelīc þǣm mangere þe sōhte þæt gōde mere-grot.
text_bare: Eft is heofona rice gelic þæm mangere þe sohte þæt gode mere-grot.

text: Þā hīe þā þæt nett ūp ātugon, and sǣton be þǣm strande, þā gecuron hīe þā gōdan on hiera fatu, and þā yflan hīe āwurpon ūt.
text_bare: Þa hie þa þæt nett up atugon, and sæton be þæm strande, þa gecuron hie þa godan on hiera fatu, and þa yflan hie awurpon ut.

text: Gif hwelc mann hæfþ hund scēapa, and him losaþ ān of þǣm, hū, ne forlǣtt hē þā nigon and hundnigontig on þǣm muntum, and gǣþ, and sēcþ þæt ān þe forwearþ?
text_bare: Gif hwelc mann hæfþ hund sceapa, and him losaþ an of þæm, hu, ne forlætt he þa nigon and hundnigontig on þæm muntum, and gæþ, and secþ þæt an þe forwearþ?

text: And gif hit gelimpþ þæt hē hit fint, sōþlīce ic ēow secge þæt hē swīþor geblissaþ for þǣm ānum þonne for þǣm nigon and hundnigontigum þe nā ne losodon.
text_bare: And gif hit gelimpþ þæt he hit fint, soþlice ic eow secge þæt he swiþor geblissaþ for þæm anum þonne for þæm nigon and hundnigontigum þe na ne losodon.

text: Heofona rīce is gelīc þǣm hīredes ealdre, þe on ǣrnemergen ūt ēode āhȳran wyrhtan on his wīn-geard.
text_bare: Heofona rice is gelic þæm hiredes ealdre, þe on ærnemergen ut eode ahyran wyrhtan on his win-geard.

text: Gewordenre gecwid-rǣdenne þǣm wyrhtum, hē sealde ǣlcum ānne þening wiþ his dæges weorce, and āsende hīe on his wīngeard.
text_bare: Gewordenre gecwid-rædenne þæm wyrhtum, he sealde ælcum anne þening wiþ his dæges weorce, and asende hie on his wingeard.

text: And þā hē ūt ēode ymbe undern-tīd, hē geseah oþre on strǣte īdle standan.
text_bare: And þa he ut eode ymbe undern-tid, he geseah oþre on stræte idle standan.

text: Þā cwæþ hē: 'Gā gē on mīnne wīngeard, and ic selle ēow þæt riht biþ.' And hīe þā fērdon.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ he: 'Ga ge on minne wingeard, and ic selle eow þæt riht biþ.' And hie þa ferdon.

text: Eft hē ūt ēode ymbe þā siextan and nigoþan tīd, and dyde þǣm swā gelīce.
text_bare: Eft he ut eode ymbe þa siextan and nigoþan tid, and dyde þæm swa gelice.

text: Þā ymbe þā endlyftan tīd hē ūt ēode, and funde ōþre standende, and þā sægde hē: 'Hwȳ stande gē hēr ealne daeg īdle?' Þā cwǣdon hīe: 'For þǣm þe ūs nān mann ne hȳrde.' Þā cwæþ hē: 'And gā gē on mīnne wīngeard.' Sōþlīce þā hit wæs ǣfen geworden, þā sægde se wīngeardes hlāford his gerēfan: 'Clipa þā wyrhtan, and āgief him hiera mēde; onginn fram þǣm ȳtemestan oþ þone fyrmestan.' Eornostlīce þā þā gecōmon þe ymbe þā endlyftan tīd cōmon, þā onfēngon hīe ǣlc his pening.
text_bare: Þa ymbe þa endlyftan tid he ut eode, and funde oþre standende, and þa sægde he: 'Hwy stande ge her ealne daeg idle?' Þa cwædon hie: 'For þæm þe us nan mann ne hyrde.' Þa cwæþ he: 'And ga ge on minne wingeard.' Soþlice þa hit wæs æfen geworden, þa sægde se wingeardes hlaford his gerefan: 'Clipa þa wyrhtan, and agief him hiera mede; onginn fram þæm ytemestan oþ þone fyrmestan.' Eornostlice þa þa gecomon þe ymbe þa endlyftan tid comon, þa onfengon hie ælc his pening.

text: And þā þe þǣr ǣrest cōmon, wēndon þæt hīe scolden māre onfōn; þā onfēngon hīe syndrige þeningas.
text_bare: And þa þe þær ærest comon, wendon þæt hie scolden mare onfon; þa onfengon hie syndrige þeningas.

text: Þa ongunnon hīe murcnian ongēan þone hīredes ealdor, and þus cwǣdon: 'Þās ȳtemestan worhton āne tīd, and þū dydest hīe gelīce ūs, þe bǣron byrþenna on þisses dæges hǣtan.' Þā cwæþ hē and-swariende hiera ānum: 'Ēalā þū frēond, ne dō ic þē nānne tēonan; hū, ne cōme þū tō mē tō wyrcenne wiþ ānum peninge?
text_bare: Þa ongunnon hie murcnian ongean þone hiredes ealdor, and þus cwædon: 'Þas ytemestan worhton ane tid, and þu dydest hie gelice us, þe bæron byrþenna on þisses dæges hætan.' Þa cwæþ he and-swariende hiera anum: 'Eala þu freond, ne do ic þe nanne teonan; hu, ne come þu to me to wyrcenne wiþ anum peninge?

text: Nim þæt þīn is, and gā; ic wile þissum ȳtemestum sellan eall swā micel swā þē.
text_bare: Nim þæt þin is, and ga; ic wile þissum ytemestum sellan eall swa micel swa þe.

text: Hwæþer þe þīn ēage mānfull is for þǣm þe ic gōd eom?
text_bare: Hwæþer þe þin eage manfull is for þæm þe ic god eom?

text: Swā bēoþ þa fyrmestan ȳtemeste, and þā ȳtemestan fyrmeste; sōþlīce manige sind geclipode, and fēa gecorene.' .
text_bare: Swa beoþ þa fyrmestan ytemeste, and þa ytemestan fyrmeste; soþlice manige sind geclipode, and fea gecorene.' .

text: Heofona rīce is gelīc þǣm cyninge þe macode his suna giefta, and sende his þēowas, and clipode þā gelaþodan tō þǣm gieftum.
text_bare: Heofona rice is gelic þæm cyninge þe macode his suna giefta, and sende his þeowas, and clipode þa gelaþodan to þæm gieftum.

text: Þā noldon hīe cuman.
text_bare: Þa noldon hie cuman.

text: Þā sende hē eft ōþre þēowas, and sægde þǣm gelaþodum: 'Nū ic gegearwode mīne feorme: mīne fearras and mīne fuglas sind ofslægene, and eall mīn þing sind gearu; cumaþ tō þǣm gieftum.' Þā forgīemdon hīe þæt, and fērdon, sum tō his tūne, sum tō his mangunge.
text_bare: Þa sende he eft oþre þeowas, and sægde þæm gelaþodum: 'Nu ic gegearwode mine feorme: mine fearras and mine fuglas sind ofslægene, and eall min þing sind gearu; cumaþ to þæm gieftum.' Þa forgiemdon hie þæt, and ferdon, sum to his tune, sum to his mangunge.

text: And þā ōþre nāmon his þēowas, and mid tēonan geswencton, and ofslōgon.
text_bare: And þa oþre namon his þeowas, and mid teonan geswencton, and ofslogon.

text: Þā se cyning þæt gehierde, þā wæs hē ierre, and sende his here tō, and fordyde þā mann-slagan, and hiera burg forbærnde.
text_bare: Þa se cyning þæt gehierde, þa wæs he ierre, and sende his here to, and fordyde þa mann-slagan, and hiera burg forbærnde.

text: Þā cwæþ hē tō his þēowum: 'Witodlīce þās giefta sind gearwe, ac þā þe gelaþode wǣron ne sind wierþe.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ he to his þeowum: 'Witodlice þas giefta sind gearwe, ac þa þe gelaþode wæron ne sind wierþe.

text: Gāþ nū tō wega gelǣtum, and clipiaþ tō þissum gieftum swā hwelce swā gē gemēten.' Þā ēodon þā þēowas ūt on þā wegas, and gegadrodon ealle þā þe hīe gemētton, gōde and yfle; þā wǣron þā gieft-hūs mid sittendum mannum gefyldu.
text_bare: Gaþ nu to wega gelætum, and clipiaþ to þissum gieftum swa hwelce swa ge gemeten.' Þa eodon þa þeowas ut on þa wegas, and gegadrodon ealle þa þe hie gemetton, gode and yfle; þa wæron þa gieft-hus mid sittendum mannum gefyldu.

text: Þā ēode se cyning inn, þæt hē wolde gesēon þā þe þǣr sǣton, and þā geseah hē þǣr ānne mann þe næs mid gieftlicum rēafe gescrȳdd.
text_bare: Þa eode se cyning inn, þæt he wolde geseon þa þe þær sæton, and þa geseah he þær anne mann þe næs mid gieftlicum reafe gescrydd.

text: Þā cwæþ hē: 'Lā, frēond, hūmeta ēodest þū inn, and næfdest gieftlic rēaf?' Þa swīgode hē.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ he: 'La, freond, humeta eodest þu inn, and næfdest gieftlic reaf?' Þa swigode he.

text: And se cyning cwæþ tō his þegnum: 'Gebindaþ his handa and his fēt, and weorpaþ hine on þā ȳterran þēostru; þǣr biþ wōp and tōþa grīst-bītung.' Witodlīce manige sind gelaþode, and fēa gecorene.
text_bare: And se cyning cwæþ to his þegnum: 'Gebindaþ his handa and his fet, and weorpaþ hine on þa yterran þeostru; þær biþ wop and toþa grist-bitung.' Witodlice manige sind gelaþode, and fea gecorene.

text: Þonne biþ heofona rīce gelīc þǣm tīen fǣmnum, þe þā leoht-fatu nāmon, and fērdon ongēan þone brȳd-guman and þā brȳd.
text_bare: Þonne biþ heofona rice gelic þæm tien fæmnum, þe þa leoht-fatu namon, and ferdon ongean þone bryd-guman and þa bryd.

text: And þā fīf dysigan nāmon leohtfatu, and ne nāmon nānne ele mid him; þā glēawan nāmon ele on hiera fatum mid þǣm leohtfatum.
text_bare: And þa fif dysigan namon leohtfatu, and ne namon nanne ele mid him; þa gleawan namon ele on hiera fatum mid þæm leohtfatum.

text: Þā se brȳdguma ielde, þā hnappodon hīe ealle, and slēpon.
text_bare: Þa se brydguma ielde, þa hnappodon hie ealle, and slepon.

text: Witodlīce tō middre nihte man hrīemde, and cwæþ: 'Nū se brȳdguma cymþ, faraþ him tōgēanes.' Þā ārison ealle þā fǣmnan, and glengdon hiera leohtfatu.
text_bare: Witodlice to middre nihte man hriemde, and cwæþ: 'Nu se brydguma cymþ, faraþ him togeanes.' Þa arison ealle þa fæmnan, and glengdon hiera leohtfatu.

text: Þā cwǣdon þā dysigan to pǣm wīsum: 'Sellaþ ūs of ēowrum ele, for þǣm ūre leohtfatu sind ācwenctu.' Þā andswarodon þā glēawan, and cwǣdon: 'Nese; þȳ lǣs þe wē and gē næbben genōg: gāþ tō þǣm cīependum, and bycgaþ ēow ele.' Witodlīce, þā hīe fērdon, and woldon bycgan, þā cōm se brȳdguma; and þā þe gearwe wǣron ēodon inn mid him tō þǣm gieftum; and sēo duru wæs belocen.
text_bare: Þa cwædon þa dysigan to pæm wisum: 'Sellaþ us of eowrum ele, for þæm ure leohtfatu sind acwenctu.' Þa andswarodon þa gleawan, and cwædon: 'Nese; þy læs þe we and ge næbben genog: gaþ to þæm ciependum, and bycgaþ eow ele.' Witodlice, þa hie ferdon, and woldon bycgan, þa com se brydguma; and þa þe gearwe wæron eodon inn mid him to þæm gieftum; and seo duru wæs belocen.

text: Þā æt nīehstan cōmon þa ōþre fǣmnan, and cwǣdon: 'Dryhten, Dryhten, lǣt ūs inn.' Þā and-swarode hē him, and cwæþ: 'Sōþ ic ēow secge, ne cann ic ēow.' Witodlīce, waciaþ, for þǣm þe gē nyton ne þone dæg ne þā tīd.
text_bare: Þa æt niehstan comon þa oþre fæmnan, and cwædon: 'Dryhten, Dryhten, læt us inn.' Þa and-swarode he him, and cwæþ: 'Soþ ic eow secge, ne cann ic eow.' Witodlice, waciaþ, for þæm þe ge nyton ne þone dæg ne þa tid.

text: Sum mann fērde on elþēodignesse, and clipode his þēowas, and betǣhte him his ǣhta.
text_bare: Sum mann ferde on elþeodignesse, and clipode his þeowas, and betæhte him his æhta.

text: And ānum hē sealde fīf pund, sumum twā, sumum ān: ǣghwelcum be his āgnum mægne; and fērde sōna.
text_bare: And anum he sealde fif pund, sumum twa, sumum an: æghwelcum be his agnum mægne; and ferde sona.

text: Þā fērde sē þe þā fīf pund underfēng, and gestrīende ōþru fīf.
text_bare: Þa ferde se þe þa fif pund underfeng, and gestriende oþru fif.

text: And eall-swā sē þe þā twā underfeng, gestrīende ōþru twā.
text_bare: And eall-swa se þe þa twa underfeng, gestriende oþru twa.

text: Witodlīce sē þe þæt ān underfēng, fērde, and bedealf hit on eorþan, and behȳdde his hlāfordes feoh.
text_bare: Witodlice se þe þæt an underfeng, ferde, and bedealf hit on eorþan, and behydde his hlafordes feoh.

text: Witodlīce æfter miclum fierste cōm þāra þēowa hlāford, and dihte him gerad.
text_bare: Witodlice æfter miclum fierste com þara þeowa hlaford, and dihte him gerad.

text: Þā cōm sē þe þā fīf pund underfēng, and brōhte ōþru fīf, and cwæþ: 'Hlāford, fīf pund þū sealdest mē; nū ic gestrīende ōþru fīf.' Þā cwæp his hlāford tō him: 'Bēo blīþe, þū gōda þēow and getrēowa: for þǣm þe þū wǣre getrēowe ofer lȳtlu þing, ic .gesette þē ofer miclu; gā intō þīnes hlāfordes blisse.' Þā cōm sē þe þā twā pund underfēng, and cwæþ: 'Hlāford, twā pund þū mē sealdest; nū ic hæbbe gestrīened ōþru twā.' Þā cwæþ his hlāford tō him: 'Geblissa, þū gōda þēow and getrēowa: for þǣm þe þū wǣre getrēowe ofer fēa, ofer fela ic þē gesette; gā on þīnes hlāfordes gefēan.' Þā cōm sē þe þæt ān pund underfēng, and cwæþ: 'Hlāford, ic wāt þæt þū eart heard mann: þū rīpst þǣr þū ne sēowe, and gaderast þǣr þū ne sprengdest.
text_bare: Þa com se þe þa fif pund underfeng, and brohte oþru fif, and cwæþ: 'Hlaford, fif pund þu sealdest me; nu ic gestriende oþru fif.' Þa cwæp his hlaford to him: 'Beo bliþe, þu goda þeow and getreowa: for þæm þe þu wære getreowe ofer lytlu þing, ic .gesette þe ofer miclu; ga into þines hlafordes blisse.' Þa com se þe þa twa pund underfeng, and cwæþ: 'Hlaford, twa pund þu me sealdest; nu ic hæbbe gestriened oþru twa.' Þa cwæþ his hlaford to him: 'Geblissa, þu goda þeow and getreowa: for þæm þe þu wære getreowe ofer fea, ofer fela ic þe gesette; ga on þines hlafordes gefean.' Þa com se þe þæt an pund underfeng, and cwæþ: 'Hlaford, ic wat þæt þu eart heard mann: þu ripst þær þu ne seowe, and gaderast þær þu ne sprengdest.

text: And ic fērde ofdrǣdd, and behȳdde þīn pund on eorþan; hēr þū hæfst þæt þīn is.' Þā andswarode his hlāford him, and cwæþ: 'þū yfla þēow and slāwa, þū wistest þæt ic rīpe þǣr ic ne sēowe, and ic gadrige þǣr ic ne strēdde: hit gebyrede þæt þū befæste mīn feoh myneterum, and ic nāme, þonne ic cōme, þæt mīn is, mid þǣm gafole.
text_bare: And ic ferde ofdrædd, and behydde þin pund on eorþan; her þu hæfst þæt þin is.' Þa andswarode his hlaford him, and cwæþ: 'þu yfla þeow and slawa, þu wistest þæt ic ripe þær ic ne seowe, and ic gadrige þær ic ne stredde: hit gebyrede þæt þu befæste min feoh myneterum, and ic name, þonne ic come, þæt min is, mid þæm gafole.

text: Ānimaþ þæt pund æt him, and sellaþ þǣm þe mē þā tīen pund brōhte.
text_bare: Animaþ þæt pund æt him, and sellaþ þæm þe me þa tien pund brohte.

text: Witodlīce ǣlcum þāra þe hæfþ man selþ, and hē hæfþ genōg; þǣm þe næfþ, þæt him þyncþ þæt hē hæbbe, þæt him biþ ætbrogden.
text_bare: Witodlice ælcum þara þe hæfþ man selþ, and he hæfþ genog; þæm þe næfþ, þæt him þyncþ þæt he hæbbe, þæt him biþ ætbrogden.

text: And weorpaþ þone unnyttan þēow on þā ȳterran þēostru; þǣr biþ wōp and tōþa gristbītung.'
text_bare: And weorpaþ þone unnyttan þeow on þa yterran þeostru; þær biþ wop and toþa gristbitung.'

text: Æfter þǣm sōþlīce ealle menn sprǣcon āne sprǣce.
text_bare: Æfter þæm soþlice ealle menn spræcon ane spræce.

text: Þā þā hīe fērdon fram Ēast-dǣle, hīe fundon ānne feld on Sennaār-lande, and wunodon þǣr-on.
text_bare: Þa þa hie ferdon fram East-dæle, hie fundon anne feld on Sennaar-lande, and wunodon þær-on.

text: Þā cwǣdon hīe him betwēonan: 'Uton wyrcan ūs tigelan, and ǣlan hīe on fȳre!' Witodlīce hīe hæfdon tigelan for stān and tierwan for weal-līm.
text_bare: Þa cwædon hie him betweonan: 'Uton wyrcan us tigelan, and ælan hie on fyre!' Witodlice hie hæfdon tigelan for stan and tierwan for weal-lim.

text: And hīe cwǣdon: 'Uton timbrian ūs ceastre, and stīepel oþ heofon hēanne!
text_bare: And hie cwædon: 'Uton timbrian us ceastre, and stiepel oþ heofon heanne!

text: uton weorþian ūrne naman, ǣr þæm þe wē sīen tōdǣlde geond ealle eorþan!' Witodlīce Dryhten āstāg niþer, tō þǣm þæt hē gesāwe þā burg and þone stīepel, þe Adāmes bearn getimbrodon.
text_bare: uton weorþian urne naman, ær þæm þe we sien todælde geond ealle eorþan!' Witodlice Dryhten astag niþer, to þæm þæt he gesawe þa burg and þone stiepel, þe Adames bearn getimbrodon.

text: And hē cwæþ: 'þis is ān folc, and ealle hīe sprecaþ ān læden, and hīe begunnon þis tō wyrcenne: ne geswīcaþ hīe ǣr þǣm þe hit gearu sīe; sōþlīce uton cuman and tōdǣlan hiera sprǣce!' Swā Dryhten hīe tōdǣlde of þǣre stōwe geond ealle eorþan.
text_bare: And he cwæþ: 'þis is an folc, and ealle hie sprecaþ an læden, and hie begunnon þis to wyrcenne: ne geswicaþ hie ær þæm þe hit gearu sie; soþlice uton cuman and todælan hiera spræce!' Swa Dryhten hie todælde of þære stowe geond ealle eorþan.

text: And for þǣm man nemnde þā stōwe Babēl for þǣm þe þǣr wǣron tōdǣlde ealle sprǣca.
text_bare: And for þæm man nemnde þa stowe Babel for þæm þe þær wæron todælde ealle spræca.

text: God wolde pā fandian Abrahāmes gehīersumnesse, and clipode his naman, and cwæþ him þus tō: 'Nim þīnne ān-cennedan sunu Isaāc, þe þū lufast, and far tō þǣm lande Visionis hraþe, and geoffra hine þǣr uppan ānre dūne.' Abrahām þā ārās on þǣre ilcan nihte, and fērde mid twǣm cnapum tō þǣm fierlenum lande, and Isaāc samod, on assum rīdende.
text_bare: God wolde pa fandian Abrahames gehiersumnesse, and clipode his naman, and cwæþ him þus to: 'Nim þinne an-cennedan sunu Isaac, þe þu lufast, and far to þæm lande Visionis hraþe, and geoffra hine þær uppan anre dune.' Abraham þa aras on þære ilcan nihte, and ferde mid twæm cnapum to þæm fierlenum lande, and Isaac samod, on assum ridende.

text: Þā on þǣm þriddan dæge, þā hīe þā dūne gesāwon, þǣr þǣr hīe tō scoldon tō ofslēanne Isaāc, þā cwæþ Abrahām tō þǣm twǣm cnapum þus: 'Andbīdiaþ ēow hēr mid þǣm assum sume hwīle!
text_bare: Þa on þæm þriddan dæge, þa hie þa dune gesawon, þær þær hie to scoldon to ofsleanne Isaac, þa cwæþ Abraham to þæm twæm cnapum þus: 'Andbidiaþ eow her mid þæm assum sume hwile!

text: ic and þǣt cild gāþ unc tō gebiddenne, and wit siþþan cumaþ sōna eft tō ēow.' Abrahām þā hēt Isaāc beran þone wudu tō þǣre stōwe, and hē self bær his sweord and fȳr.
text_bare: ic and þæt cild gaþ unc to gebiddenne, and wit siþþan cumaþ sona eft to eow.' Abraham þa het Isaac beran þone wudu to þære stowe, and he self bær his sweord and fyr.

text: Isaāc þa āscode Abrahām his fæder: 'Fæder mīn, ic āscige hwǣr sēo offrung sīe; hēr is wudu and fȳr.' Him andwyrde se fæder: 'God forescēawaþ, mīn sunu, him self þā offrunge.' Hīe cōmon þā tō þǣre stōwe þe him gesweotolode God; and hē þǣr weofod ārǣrde on þā ealdan wīsan, and þone wudu gelōgode swā swā hē hit wolde habban tō his suna bærnette, siþþan hē ofslægen wurde.
text_bare: Isaac þa ascode Abraham his fæder: 'Fæder min, ic ascige hwær seo offrung sie; her is wudu and fyr.' Him andwyrde se fæder: 'God foresceawaþ, min sunu, him self þa offrunge.' Hie comon þa to þære stowe þe him gesweotolode God; and he þær weofod arærde on þa ealdan wisan, and þone wudu gelogode swa swa he hit wolde habban to his suna bærnette, siþþan he ofslægen wurde.

text: Hē geband þā his sunu, and his sweord ātēah, þæt hē hine geoffrode on þā ealdan wīsan.
text_bare: He geband þa his sunu, and his sweord ateah, þæt he hine geoffrode on þa ealdan wisan.

text: Mid þǣm þe hē wolde þǣt weorc beginnan, þā clipode Godes engel arodlīce of heofonum: 'Abrahām!' Hē andwyrde sōna.
text_bare: Mid þæm þe he wolde þæt weorc beginnan, þa clipode Godes engel arodlice of heofonum: 'Abraham!' He andwyrde sona.

text: Se engel him cwæþ tō: 'Ne ācwele þū þæt cild, ne þīne hand ne āstrece ofer his swēoran!
text_bare: Se engel him cwæþ to: 'Ne acwele þu þæt cild, ne þine hand ne astrece ofer his sweoran!

text: Nū ic oncnēow sōþlīce þæt pū ondrǣtst swīþe God, nū pū pīnne ān-cennedan sunu woldest ofslēan for him.' Þā beseah Abrahām sōna under bæc, and geseah þǣr ānne ramm betwix þǣm brēmlum be þǣm hornum gehæftne, and hē hæfde þone ramm tō þǣre offrunge, and hine þǣr ofsnāþ Gode tō lāce for his sunu Isaāc.
text_bare: Nu ic oncneow soþlice þæt pu ondrætst swiþe God, nu pu pinne an-cennedan sunu woldest ofslean for him.' Þa beseah Abraham sona under bæc, and geseah þær anne ramm betwix þæm bremlum be þæm hornum gehæftne, and he hæfde þone ramm to þære offrunge, and hine þær ofsnaþ Gode to lace for his sunu Isaac.

text: Hē hēt þā stōwe swā, In monte Dominus videbit, þæt is, 'God gesihþ on dūne.' Eft clipode se engel Abrahām, and cwæþ: 'Ic sægde þurh mē selfne, sægde se Ælmihtiga, nū þū noldest ārian þīnum āncennedum suna, ac þē wæs mīn ege māre þonne his līf, ic þē nū blētsige, and þīnne of-spring gemanig-fielde swā swā steorran on heofonum, and swā swā sand-ceosol on sǣ; þīn ofspring sceal āgan hiera fēonda geatu.
text_bare: He het þa stowe swa, In monte Dominus videbit, þæt is, 'God gesihþ on dune.' Eft clipode se engel Abraham, and cwæþ: 'Ic sægde þurh me selfne, sægde se Ælmihtiga, nu þu noldest arian þinum ancennedum suna, ac þe wæs min ege mare þonne his lif, ic þe nu bletsige, and þinne of-spring gemanig-fielde swa swa steorran on heofonum, and swa swa sand-ceosol on sæ; þin ofspring sceal agan hiera feonda geatu.

text: And on þīnum sǣde bēoþ ealle þēoda geblētsode, for þǣm þe þū gehīersumodest mīnre hǣse þus.' Abrahām þā gecierde sōna tō his cnapum, and fērdon him hām sōna mid heofonlicre blētsunge.
text_bare: And on þinum sæde beoþ ealle þeoda gebletsode, for þæm þe þu gehiersumodest minre hæse þus.' Abraham þa gecierde sona to his cnapum, and ferdon him ham sona mid heofonlicre bletsunge.

text: Sum cwēn wæs on sūþ-dǣle, Saba gehāten, snotor and wīs.
text_bare: Sum cwen wæs on suþ-dæle, Saba gehaten, snotor and wis.

text: Þā gehīerde hēo Salomones hlīsan, and cōm fram þǣm sūþernum gemǣrum to Salomone binnan Hierusalēm mid micelre fare, and hiere olfendas bǣron sūþerne wyrta, and dēor-wierþe gimm-stānas, and un-gerīm gold.
text_bare: Þa gehierde heo Salomones hlisan, and com fram þæm suþernum gemærum to Salomone binnan Hierusalem mid micelre fare, and hiere olfendas bæron suþerne wyrta, and deor-wierþe gimm-stanas, and un-gerim gold.

text: Sēo cwēn þā hæfde sprǣce wiþ Salomon, and sægde him swā hwæt swā hēo on hiere heortan geþōhte.
text_bare: Seo cwen þa hæfde spræce wiþ Salomon, and sægde him swa hwæt swa heo on hiere heortan geþohte.

text: Salomon þā hīe lǣrde, and hiere sægde ealra þāra worda andgiet þe hēo hine āscode.
text_bare: Salomon þa hie lærde, and hiere sægde ealra þara worda andgiet þe heo hine ascode.

text: Þā geseah sēo cwēn Salomones wīsdōm, and þæt mǣre tempel þe hē getimbrod hæfde, and þā lāc þe man Gode offrode, and þæs cyninges manig-fealde þegnunga, and wæs tō þǣm swīþe ofwundrod þæt hēo næfde furþor nānne gāst, for þǣm þe hēo ne mihte nā furþor smēan.
text_bare: Þa geseah seo cwen Salomones wisdom, and þæt mære tempel þe he getimbrod hæfde, and þa lac þe man Gode offrode, and þæs cyninges manig-fealde þegnunga, and wæs to þæm swiþe ofwundrod þæt heo næfde furþor nanne gast, for þæm þe heo ne mihte na furþor smean.

text: Hēo cwæþ þā tō þǣm cyninge: 'Sōþ is þæt word þe ic gehīerde on mīnum earde be þē and be þīnum wīsdōme, ac ic nolde gelīefan ǣr þǣm þe ic self hit gesāwe.
text_bare: Heo cwæþ þa to þæm cyninge: 'Soþ is þæt word þe ic gehierde on minum earde be þe and be þinum wisdome, ac ic nolde geliefan ær þæm þe ic self hit gesawe.

text: Nū hæbbe ic āfandod þæt mē næs be healfum dǣle þīn mǣrþo gecȳped.
text_bare: Nu hæbbe ic afandod þæt me næs be healfum dæle þin mærþo gecyped.

text: Māre is þīn wīsdōm and þīn weorc þonne se hlīsa wǣre þe ic gehīerde.
text_bare: Mare is þin wisdom and þin weorc þonne se hlisa wære þe ic gehierde.

text: Ēadige sind þīne þegnas and þīne þēowas, þe simle ætforan þē standaþ, and þīnne wīsdōm gehīeraþ.
text_bare: Eadige sind þine þegnas and þine þeowas, þe simle ætforan þe standaþ, and þinne wisdom gehieraþ.

text: Geblētsod sīe se ælmihtiga God, þe þē gecēas and gesette ofer Israhēla rīce, þæt þū dōmas sette and riht-wīsnesse,' Hēo forgeaf þǣem cyninge þā hundtwelftig punda goldes, and ungerīm dēorwierþra wyrta and dēorwierþra gimmstāna.
text_bare: Gebletsod sie se ælmihtiga God, þe þe geceas and gesette ofer Israhela rice, þæt þu domas sette and riht-wisnesse,' Heo forgeaf þæem cyninge þa hundtwelftig punda goldes, and ungerim deorwierþra wyrta and deorwierþra gimmstana.

text: Salomon ēac forgeaf þǣre cwēne swā hwæs swā hēo giernde æt him; and hēo gewende ongeān tō hiere ēþle mid hiere þegnum.
text_bare: Salomon eac forgeaf þære cwene swa hwæs swa heo giernde æt him; and heo gewende ongean to hiere eþle mid hiere þegnum.

text: Salomon þā wæs gemǣrsod ofer eallum eorþlicum cyningum, and ealle þēoda gewilnodon þæt hīe hine gesāwen, and his wīsdōm gehīerden, and hīe him manigfeald lāc brōhton.
text_bare: Salomon þa wæs gemærsod ofer eallum eorþlicum cyningum, and ealle þeoda gewilnodon þæt hie hine gesawen, and his wisdom gehierden, and hie him manigfeald lac brohton.

text: Sēo cwēn hæfde getācnunge þǣre hālgan gelaþunge ealles crīstenes folces, þe cōm tō þǣm gesibbsuman Crīste tō gehīerenne his wīsdōm and þā god-spellican lāre þa hē āstealde, and be onliehtunge þæs sōþan gelēafan, and be þǣm tōweardan dōme, be ūrre sāwle un-dēadlicnesse, and be hyhte and wuldre þæs gemǣnelican ǣristes.
text_bare: Seo cwen hæfde getacnunge þære halgan gelaþunge ealles cristenes folces, þe com to þæm gesibbsuman Criste to gehierenne his wisdom and þa god-spellican lare þa he astealde, and be onliehtunge þæs soþan geleafan, and be þæm toweardan dome, be urre sawle un-deadlicnesse, and be hyhte and wuldre þæs gemænelican æristes.

text: Sēo cwēn cōm tō Salomone mid miclum lācum on golde and on dēorwierþum gimmstānum and wyrt-brǣþum; and þæt bǣron olfendas.
text_bare: Seo cwen com to Salomone mid miclum lacum on golde and on deorwierþum gimmstanum and wyrt-bræþum; and þæt bæron olfendas.

text: Sēo gelēaffulle gelaþung, þe cymþ of ǣlcum earde tō Crīste, bringþ him þās fore-sægdan lāc æfter gāstlicum andgiete.
text_bare: Seo geleaffulle gelaþung, þe cymþ of ælcum earde to Criste, bringþ him þas fore-sægdan lac æfter gastlicum andgiete.

text: Hēo offraþ him gold þurh sōþne gelēafan, and wyrtbrǣþas þurh gebedu, and dēorwierþe gimmas þurh fægernesse gōdra þēawa and hāligra mægna.
text_bare: Heo offraþ him gold þurh soþne geleafan, and wyrtbræþas þurh gebedu, and deorwierþe gimmas þurh fægernesse godra þeawa and haligra mægna.

text: Be þisse gelaþunge cwæþ se wītega tō Gode: Adstitit þæt is, 'sēo cwēn stent æt þīnre swīþran, on ofergyldum gierlan, ymbscrȳdd mid manigfealdre fāgnesse.' Sēo gāstlice cwēn, Godes gelaþung, is geglenged mid dēorwierþre frætwunge and manigfealdum blēo gōdra drohtnunga and mihta.
text_bare: Be þisse gelaþunge cwæþ se witega to Gode: Adstitit þæt is, 'seo cwen stent æt þinre swiþran, on ofergyldum gierlan, ymbscrydd mid manigfealdre fagnesse.' Seo gastlice cwen, Godes gelaþung, is geglenged mid deorwierþre frætwunge and manigfealdum bleo godra drohtnunga and mihta.

text: Hēo sægde Salomone ealle hiere dīegolnessa, and sēo gelaþung geopenaþ Crīste hiere inn-gehygd and þa dīeglan geþōhtas on sōþre andetnesse.
text_bare: Heo sægde Salomone ealle hiere diegolnessa, and seo gelaþung geopenaþ Criste hiere inn-gehygd and þa dieglan geþohtas on soþre andetnesse.

text: Olfendas bǣron þā dēorwierþan lāc mid þǣre cwēne intō Hierusalēm; for þǣm þe þā hǣþnan, þe ǣr wǣron gehoferode þurh gītsunge and atollice þurh leahtras, bǣron, þurh hiera gecierrednesse and gelēafan, þā gāstlican lāc tō Crīstes handum.
text_bare: Olfendas bæron þa deorwierþan lac mid þære cwene into Hierusalem; for þæm þe þa hæþnan, þe ær wæron gehoferode þurh gitsunge and atollice þurh leahtras, bæron, þurh hiera gecierrednesse and geleafan, þa gastlican lac to Cristes handum.

text: Sēo cwēn wundrode Salomones wīsdōmes, and his getimbrunga, and þegnunga; and sēo gelaþung wundraþ Crīstes wīsdōmes, for þǣm þe hē is sōþ wīsdōm, and eall wīsdōm is of him.
text_bare: Seo cwen wundrode Salomones wisdomes, and his getimbrunga, and þegnunga; and seo gelaþung wundraþ Cristes wisdomes, for þæm þe he is soþ wisdom, and eall wisdom is of him.

text: Hē getimbrode þā hēalican heofonas and ealne middangeard, and ealle gesceafta gesette on þrim þingum, on hefe, and on getele.
text_bare: He getimbrode þa healican heofonas and ealne middangeard, and ealle gesceafta gesette on þrim þingum, on hefe, and on getele.

text: Crīstes þegnung is ūre hǣlo and folca ālīesednes, and þā sind gesǣlige þe him þegniaþ tō gecwēmednesse on þǣm gāstlicum gerȳnum.
text_bare: Cristes þegnung is ure hælo and folca aliesednes, and þa sind gesælige þe him þegniaþ to gecwemednesse on þæm gastlicum gerynum.

text: Sēo cwēn sægde þæt hiere nǣre be healfum dǣle gesægd be Salomones mǣrþo, and sēo gāstlice cwēn, Godes gelaþung, oþþe gehwelc hālig sāwol, þonne hēo cymþ tō þǣre heofonlican Hierusalēm, þonne gesihþ hēo micle māran mǣrþo and wuldor þonne hiere ǣr on līfe þurh wītegan oþþe apostolas gecȳdd wǣre.
text_bare: Seo cwen sægde þæt hiere nære be healfum dæle gesægd be Salomones mærþo, and seo gastlice cwen, Godes gelaþung, oþþe gehwelc halig sawol, þonne heo cymþ to þære heofonlican Hierusalem, þonne gesihþ heo micle maran mærþo and wuldor þonne hiere ær on life þurh witegan oþþe apostolas gecydd wære.

text: Ne mæg nān ēage on þissum līfe gesēon, ne nān ēare gehīeran, ne nānes mannes heorte āsmēan þā þing þe God gearcaþ þǣm þe hine lufiaþ.
text_bare: Ne mæg nan eage on þissum life geseon, ne nan eare gehieran, ne nanes mannes heorte asmean þa þing þe God gearcaþ þæm þe hine lufiaþ.

text: Þā þing wē magon begietan, ac wē ne magon hīe āsmēan, ne ūs nǣfre ne āþrīett þāra gōda genyhtsumnes.
text_bare: Þa þing we magon begietan, ac we ne magon hie asmean, ne us næfre ne aþriett þara goda genyhtsumnes.

text: Crīst is ealra cyninga cyning, and swā swā ealle þēoda woldon gesēon þone gesibbsuman Salomon, and his wīsdōm gehīeran, and him mislicu lāc brōhton, swā ēac nū of eallum þēodum gewilniaþ menn tō gesēonne þone ge-sibbsuman Crīst þurh gelēafan, and þone godspellican wīsdōm gehīeran, and hīe him dæg-hwǣmlīce þā gāstlican lāc geoffriaþ on manigfealdum gemetum.
text_bare: Crist is ealra cyninga cyning, and swa swa ealle þeoda woldon geseon þone gesibbsuman Salomon, and his wisdom gehieran, and him mislicu lac brohton, swa eac nu of eallum þeodum gewilniaþ menn to geseonne þone ge-sibbsuman Crist þurh geleafan, and þone godspellican wisdom gehieran, and hie him dæg-hwæmlice þa gastlican lac geoffriaþ on manigfealdum gemetum.

text: On Cȳres dagum cyninges wrēgdon þā Babilōniscan þone wītegan Daniēl, for þǣm þe hē tōwearp hiera dēofol-gield, and cwǣdon ān-mōdlīce tō þǣm fore-sægdan cyninge Cȳrum: 'Betǣc ūs Daniēl, þe ūrne god Bēl tōwearp, and þone dracan ācwealde þe wē on belīefdon; gif þū hine forstentst, wē fordilgiaþ þē and þīnne hīred.' Þā geseah se cyning þæt hīe ān-mōde wǣron, and nīedunga þone wītegan him tō handum āscēaf.
text_bare: On Cyres dagum cyninges wregdon þa Babiloniscan þone witegan Daniel, for þæm þe he towearp hiera deofol-gield, and cwædon an-modlice to þæm fore-sægdan cyninge Cyrum: 'Betæc us Daniel, þe urne god Bel towearp, and þone dracan acwealde þe we on beliefdon; gif þu hine forstentst, we fordilgiaþ þe and þinne hired.' Þa geseah se cyning þæt hie an-mode wæron, and niedunga þone witegan him to handum asceaf.

text: Hīe þā hine āwurpon intō ānum sēaþe, on þǣm wǣron seofon lēon, þǣm man sealde dæghwǣmlīce twā hrīþeru and twā scēap, ac him wæs þā oftogen ǣlces fōdan siex dagas, þæt hīe þone Godes mann ābītan scolden.
text_bare: Hie þa hine awurpon into anum seaþe, on þæm wæron seofon leon, þæm man sealde dæghwæmlice twa hriþeru and twa sceap, ac him wæs þa oftogen ælces fodan siex dagas, þæt hie þone Godes mann abitan scolden.

text: On þǣre tīde wæs sum ōþer wītega on Jūdēa-lande, his nama waes Abacuc, sē bær his rifterum mete tō æcere.
text_bare: On þære tide wæs sum oþer witega on Judea-lande, his nama waes Abacuc, se bær his rifterum mete to æcere.

text: Þā cōm him tō Godes engel, and cwæþ: 'Abacuc, ber þone mete tō Babilōne, and sele Daniēle, sē þe sitt on þāra lēona sēaþe.' Abacuc andwyrde þǣm engle: 'Lā lēof, ne geseah ic nǣfre þā burg, ne ic þone sēaþ nāt.' Þā se engel gelǣhte hine be þǣm feaxe, and hine bær tō Babilōne, and hine sette bufan þǣm sēaþe.
text_bare: Þa com him to Godes engel, and cwæþ: 'Abacuc, ber þone mete to Babilone, and sele Daniele, se þe sitt on þara leona seaþe.' Abacuc andwyrde þæm engle: 'La leof, ne geseah ic næfre þa burg, ne ic þone seaþ nat.' Þa se engel gelæhte hine be þæm feaxe, and hine bær to Babilone, and hine sette bufan þæm seaþe.

text: Þā clipode se Abacuc: 'þū Godes þēow, Daniēl, nim þās lāc þe þē God sende!' Daniēl cwæþ: 'Mīn Dryhten Hǣlend, sīe þē lof and weorþ-mynd þæt þū mē gemundest.' And hē þā þǣre sande brēac.
text_bare: Þa clipode se Abacuc: 'þu Godes þeow, Daniel, nim þas lac þe þe God sende!' Daniel cwæþ: 'Min Dryhten Hælend, sie þe lof and weorþ-mynd þæt þu me gemundest.' And he þa þære sande breac.

text: Witodlīce Godes engel þǣr-rihte mid swiftum flyhte gebrōhte þone disc-þegn, Abacuc, þǣr hē hine ǣr genam.
text_bare: Witodlice Godes engel þær-rihte mid swiftum flyhte gebrohte þone disc-þegn, Abacuc, þær he hine ær genam.

text: Se cyning þā Cȳrus on þǣm seofoþan dæge ēode drēorig tō þāra lēona sēaþe, and inn beseah, and efne þā Daniēl sittende wæs gesundfull onmiddan þǣm lēonum.
text_bare: Se cyning þa Cyrus on þæm seofoþan dæge eode dreorig to þara leona seaþe, and inn beseah, and efne þa Daniel sittende wæs gesundfull onmiddan þæm leonum.

text: Þā clipode se cyning mid micelre stefne: 'Mǣre is se God þe Daniēl on belīefþ.' And hē þā mid þǣm worde hine ātēah of þǣm scræfe, and hēt inn weorpan þā þe hine ǣr fordōn woldon.
text_bare: Þa clipode se cyning mid micelre stefne: 'Mære is se God þe Daniel on beliefþ.' And he þa mid þæm worde hine ateah of þæm scræfe, and het inn weorpan þa þe hine ær fordon woldon.

text: Þæs cyninges hǣs wearþ hrædlīce gefremmed, and þæs wītegan ēhteras wurdon āscofene betwix þā lēon, and hīe þǣr-rihte mid grǣdigum ceaflum hīe ealle tōtǣron.
text_bare: Þæs cyninges hæs wearþ hrædlice gefremmed, and þæs witegan ehteras wurdon ascofene betwix þa leon, and hie þær-rihte mid grædigum ceaflum hie ealle totæron.

text: Þā cwæþ se cyning: 'Forhtien and ondrǣden ealle eorþ-būend Daniēles God, for þǣm þe hē is Ālīesend and Hǣlend, wyrcende tācnu and wundru on heofonan and on eorþan.' Nabochodonosor, se hǣþena cyning, gehergode on Godes folce, on Jūdēa-lande, and for hiera mān-dǣdum God þæt geþafode.
text_bare: Þa cwæþ se cyning: 'Forhtien and ondræden ealle eorþ-buend Danieles God, for þæm þe he is Aliesend and Hælend, wyrcende tacnu and wundru on heofonan and on eorþan.' Nabochodonosor, se hæþena cyning, gehergode on Godes folce, on Judea-lande, and for hiera man-dædum God þæt geþafode.

text: Þā genam hē þā māþm-fatu, gyldenu and silfrenu, binnan Godes temple, and tō his lande mid him gelǣdde.
text_bare: Þa genam he þa maþm-fatu, gyldenu and silfrenu, binnan Godes temple, and to his lande mid him gelædde.

text: Hit gelamp eft siþþan þæt hē on swefne āne gesihþe be him selfum geseah, swā swā him siþþan āēode.
text_bare: Hit gelamp eft siþþan þæt he on swefne ane gesihþe be him selfum geseah, swa swa him siþþan aeode.

text: Æfter þissum ymb twelf mōnaþ, ēode se cyning binnan his healle mid ormǣtre ūp-āhafennesse, heriende his weorc and his miht, and cwæþ: 'Hū, ne is þis sēo micle Babilōn, þe ic self getimbrode tō cyne-stōle and tō þrymme, mē selfum to wlite and wuldre, mid mīnum āgnum mægne and strengþo?' Ac him clipode þǣrrihte tō swīþe egeslic stefn of heofonum, þus cweþende: 'Þū Nabochodonosor, þīn rīce gewītt fram þē, and þū bist fram mannum āworpen, and þīn wunung biþ mid wildēorum, and þū itst gærs, swā swā oxa, seofon gēar, oþ þæt þū wite þæt se hēalica God gewielt manna rīca, and þæt hē forgiefþ rīce þǣm þe hē wile.' Witodlīce on þǣre ilcan tīde wæs þēos sprǣc gefylled ofer Nabochodonosor, and hē arn tō wuda, and wunode mid wildēorum, leofode be gærse, swā swā nīeten, oþ þæt his feax wēox swā swā wīf-manna, and his næglas swā swā Eft siþþan him forgeaf se ælmihtiga Wealdend his gewitt, and hē cwæþ: 'Ic Nabochodonosor āhōf mīn ēagan ūp tō heofonum, and mīn andgiet mē wearþ forgiefen, and ic þā blētsode þone hīehstan God, and ic herede and wuldrode þone þe leofaþ on ēcnesse, for þǣm þe his miht is ēce, and his rīce stent on mǣgþe and on mǣgþe.
text_bare: Æfter þissum ymb twelf monaþ, eode se cyning binnan his healle mid ormætre up-ahafennesse, heriende his weorc and his miht, and cwæþ: 'Hu, ne is þis seo micle Babilon, þe ic self getimbrode to cyne-stole and to þrymme, me selfum to wlite and wuldre, mid minum agnum mægne and strengþo?' Ac him clipode þærrihte to swiþe egeslic stefn of heofonum, þus cweþende: 'Þu Nabochodonosor, þin rice gewitt fram þe, and þu bist fram mannum aworpen, and þin wunung biþ mid wildeorum, and þu itst gærs, swa swa oxa, seofon gear, oþ þæt þu wite þæt se healica God gewielt manna rica, and þæt he forgiefþ rice þæm þe he wile.' Witodlice on þære ilcan tide wæs þeos spræc gefylled ofer Nabochodonosor, and he arn to wuda, and wunode mid wildeorum, leofode be gærse, swa swa nieten, oþ þæt his feax weox swa swa wif-manna, and his næglas swa swa Eft siþþan him forgeaf se ælmihtiga Wealdend his gewitt, and he cwæþ: 'Ic Nabochodonosor ahof min eagan up to heofonum, and min andgiet me wearþ forgiefen, and ic þa bletsode þone hiehstan God, and ic herede and wuldrode þone þe leofaþ on ecnesse, for þæm þe his miht is ece, and his rice stent on mægþe and on mægþe.

text: Ealle eorþ-būend sind tō nāhte getealde on his wiþmetennesse.
text_bare: Ealle eorþ-buend sind to nahte getealde on his wiþmetennesse.

text: Æfter his willan hē dēþ ǣgþer ge on heofone ge on eorþan, and nis nān þing þe his mihte wiþstande, oþþe him tō cweþe 'hwȳ dēst þū swā?' On þǣre tīde mīn andgiet gewende tō mē, and ic becōm tō weorþ-mynde mīnes cyne-rīces, and mīn mennisce hīw mē becōm.
text_bare: Æfter his willan he deþ ægþer ge on heofone ge on eorþan, and nis nan þing þe his mihte wiþstande, oþþe him to cweþe 'hwy dest þu swa?' On þære tide min andgiet gewende to me, and ic becom to weorþ-mynde mines cyne-rices, and min mennisce hiw me becom.

text: Mīne witan mē sōhton, and mīn mǣrþo wearþ geēacnod.
text_bare: Mine witan me sohton, and min mærþo wearþ geeacnod.

text: Nū eornostlīce ic mǣrsige and wuldrige þone heofonlican cyning, for þǣm þe eall his weorc sind sōþ, and his wegas riht-wīse, and hē mæg geēaþ-mēdan þā þe on mōdignesse faraþ.' Þus geēaþmēdde se ælmihtiga God þone mōdigan cyning
text_bare: Nu eornostlice ic mærsige and wuldrige þone heofonlican cyning, for þæm þe eall his weorc sind soþ, and his wegas riht-wise, and he mæg geeaþ-medan þa þe on modignesse faraþ.' Þus geeaþmedde se ælmihtiga God þone modigan cyning

text: Ān mann wæs eardiende on Israhēla þēode, Manuē gehāten, of þǣre mǣgþe Dan; his wīf wæs un-tīemend, and hīe wunodon būtan cilde.
text_bare: An mann wæs eardiende on Israhela þeode, Manue gehaten, of þære mægþe Dan; his wif wæs un-tiemend, and hie wunodon butan cilde.

text: Him cōm þā gangende tō Godes engel, and cwæþ þæt hīe scolden habban sunu him gemǣnne; 'ne hē ealu ne drince nǣfre oþþe wīn, ne nāht fūles ne þicge; sē biþ Gode hālig fram his cildhāde; and man ne mōt hine efsian oþþe bescieran, for þǣm þe hē onginþ tō ālīesenne his folc, Israhēla þēode, of Philistēa þēowte.' Hēo ācende þā sunu, swā swā hiere sægde se engel, and hēt hine Samson; and hē swīþe wēox; and God hine blētsode, and Godes gāst wæs on him.
text_bare: Him com þa gangende to Godes engel, and cwæþ þæt hie scolden habban sunu him gemænne; 'ne he ealu ne drince næfre oþþe win, ne naht fules ne þicge; se biþ Gode halig fram his cildhade; and man ne mot hine efsian oþþe bescieran, for þæm þe he onginþ to aliesenne his folc, Israhela þeode, of Philistea þeowte.' Heo acende þa sunu, swa swa hiere sægde se engel, and het hine Samson; and he swiþe weox; and God hine bletsode, and Godes gast wæs on him.

text: Hē wearþ þā mihtig on micelre strengþo, swā þæt hē gelǣhte āne lēon be wege, þe hine ābītan wolde, and tōbrægd hīe tō styccum, swelce he tōtǣre sum ēaþelic ticcen.
text_bare: He wearþ þa mihtig on micelre strengþo, swa þæt he gelæhte ane leon be wege, þe hine abitan wolde, and tobrægd hie to styccum, swelce he totære sum eaþelic ticcen.

text: Hē begann þā tō winnenne wiþ þā Philistēos, and hiera fela ofslōg and tō scame tūcode, þēah þe hīe onweald hæfden ofer hīs lēode.
text_bare: He begann þa to winnenne wiþ þa Philisteos, and hiera fela ofslog and to scame tucode, þeah þe hie onweald hæfden ofer his leode.

text: Þā fērdon þā Philistēi forþ æfter Samsone, and hēton his lēode þæt hīe hine āgēafen tō hiera onwealde, þæt hīe wrecan mihten hiera tēon-rǣdenne mid tintregum on him.
text_bare: Þa ferdon þa Philistei forþ æfter Samsone, and heton his leode þæt hie hine ageafen to hiera onwealde, þæt hie wrecan mihten hiera teon-rædenne mid tintregum on him.

text: Hīe þā hine gebundon mid twǣm bæstenum rāpum and hine gelǣddon tō þǣm folce.
text_bare: Hie þa hine gebundon mid twæm bæstenum rapum and hine gelæddon to þæm folce.

text: And þā Philistēiscan þæs fægnodon swīþe; urnon him tōgēanes ealle hlȳdende; woldon hine tintregian for hiera tēonrǣdenne.
text_bare: And þa Philisteiscan þæs fægnodon swiþe; urnon him togeanes ealle hlydende; woldon hine tintregian for hiera teonrædenne.

text: Þā tōbrægd Samson bēgen his earmas, þæt þā rāpas tō-burston þe hē mid gebunden wæs.
text_bare: Þa tobrægd Samson begen his earmas, þæt þa rapas to-burston þe he mid gebunden wæs.

text: And hē gelǣhte þ a sōna sumes assan cinn-bān þe hē þǣr funde, and gefeaht wiþ hīe, and ofslōg ān þūsend mid þæs assan cinnbāne.
text_bare: And he gelæhte þ a sona sumes assan cinn-ban þe he þær funde, and gefeaht wiþ hie, and ofslog an þusend mid þæs assan cinnbane.

text: Hē wearþ þā swīþe ofþyrst for þǣm wundorlican slege, and bæd þone heofonlican God þæt hē him āsende drincan, for þǣm þe on þǣre nēawiste næs nān wæterscipe.
text_bare: He wearþ þa swiþe ofþyrst for þæm wundorlican slege, and bæd þone heofonlican God þæt he him asende drincan, for þæm þe on þære neawiste næs nan wæterscipe.

text: Þā arn of þǣn cinnbāne of ānum tēþ wæter; and Samson þā dranc, and his Dryhtne þancode.
text_bare: Þa arn of þæn cinnbane of anum teþ wæter; and Samson þa dranc, and his Dryhtne þancode.

text: Æfter þissum hē fērde tō Philistēa lande, intō ānre byrig on hiera onwealde, Gaza gehāten.
text_bare: Æfter þissum he ferde to Philistea lande, into anre byrig on hiera onwealde, Gaza gehaten.

text: And hīe þæs fægnodon; besetton þā þǣt hūs þe hē inne wunode; woldon hine geniman mid þǣm þe hē ūt ēode on ǣrne-mergen, and hine ofslēan.
text_bare: And hie þæs fægnodon; besetton þa þæt hus þe he inne wunode; woldon hine geniman mid þæm þe he ut eode on ærne-mergen, and hine ofslean.

text: Hwæt þā Samson hiera sierwunga undergeat; and ārās on middre nihte tōmiddes his fēondum, and genam þā burg-geatu, and gebær on his hrycge mid þǣm postum, swā swā hīe belocenu wǣron, ūp tō ānre dūne tō ufeweardum þǣm cnolle; and ēode swā or-sorg of hiera gesihþum.
text_bare: Hwæt þa Samson hiera sierwunga undergeat; and aras on middre nihte tomiddes his feondum, and genam þa burg-geatu, and gebær on his hrycge mid þæm postum, swa swa hie belocenu wæron, up to anre dune to ufeweardum þæm cnolle; and eode swa or-sorg of hiera gesihþum.

text: Hine beswāc swāþēah siþþan ān wīf, Dalila gehāten, of þǣm hǣþnan folce, swā þæt hē hiere sægde, þurh hiere swīcdōm bepǣht, on hwǣm his strengþo wæs and his wundorlicu miht.
text_bare: Hine beswac swaþeah siþþan an wif, Dalila gehaten, of þæm hæþnan folce, swa þæt he hiere sægde, þurh hiere swicdom bepæht, on hwæm his strengþo wæs and his wundorlicu miht.

text: Þā hǣþnan Philistēi behēton hiere sceattas wiþ þǣm þe hēo beswice Samson þone strangan.
text_bare: Þa hæþnan Philistei beheton hiere sceattas wiþ þæm þe heo beswice Samson þone strangan.

text: Þā āscode hēo hine georne mid hiere ōlǣcunge on hwǣm his miht wǣre; and hē hiere andwyrde: 'Gif ic bēo gebunden mid seofon rāpum, of sinum geworhte, sōna ic bēo gewield.' Þæt swicole wīf þā begeat þā seofon rāpas, and hē þurh sierwunge swā wearþ gebunden.
text_bare: Þa ascode heo hine georne mid hiere olæcunge on hwæm his miht wære; and he hiere andwyrde: 'Gif ic beo gebunden mid seofon rapum, of sinum geworhte, sona ic beo gewield.' Þæt swicole wif þa begeat þa seofon rapas, and he þurh sierwunge swa wearþ gebunden.

text: And him man cȳþde þæt þǣr cōmon his fīend; þā tōbræc hē sōna þā rāpas, swā swā hefel-þrǣdas; and þæt wīf nyste on hwǣm his miht wæs.
text_bare: And him man cyþde þæt þær comon his fiend; þa tobræc he sona þa rapas, swa swa hefel-þrædas; and þæt wif nyste on hwæm his miht wæs.

text: Hē wearþ eft gebunden mid eall-nīwum rāpum; and hē þā tōbræc, swā swā þā ōþre.
text_bare: He wearþ eft gebunden mid eall-niwum rapum; and he þa tobræc, swa swa þa oþre.

text: Hēo beswāc hine swāþēah, þæt hē hiere sægde æt nīehstan: 'Ic eom Gode gehālgod fram mīnum cildhāde; and ic næs nǣfre geefsod, ne nǣfre bescoren; and gif ic bēo bescoren, þonne bēo ic un-mihtig, ōþrum mannum gelīc;' and hēo lēt þā swā.
text_bare: Heo beswac hine swaþeah, þæt he hiere sægde æt niehstan: 'Ic eom Gode gehalgod fram minum cildhade; and ic næs næfre geefsod, ne næfre bescoren; and gif ic beo bescoren, þonne beo ic un-mihtig, oþrum mannum gelic;' and heo let þa swa.

text: Hēo þā on sumum dæge, þā þā hē on slǣpe læg, forcearf his seofon loccas, and āweahte hine siþþan; þā wæs hē swā unmihtig swā swā ōþre menn.
text_bare: Heo þa on sumum dæge, þa þa he on slæpe læg, forcearf his seofon loccas, and aweahte hine siþþan; þa wæs he swa unmihtig swa swa oþre menn.

text: And þā Philistēi gefēngon hine sōna, swā swā hēo hine belǣwde, and gelǣddon hine onweg; and hēo hæfde þone sceatt, swā swā him gewearþ.
text_bare: And þa Philistei gefengon hine sona, swa swa heo hine belæwde, and gelæddon hine onweg; and heo hæfde þone sceatt, swa swa him gewearþ.

text: Hīe þā hine āblendon, and gebundenne lǣddon on heardum racentēagum hām tō hiera byrig, and on cwearterne belucon tō langre fierste: hēton hine grindan æt hiera hand-cweorne.
text_bare: Hie þa hine ablendon, and gebundenne læddon on heardum racenteagum ham to hiera byrig, and on cwearterne belucon to langre fierste: heton hine grindan æt hiera hand-cweorne.

text: Þā wēoxon his loccas and his miht eft on him.
text_bare: Þa weoxon his loccas and his miht eft on him.

text: And þā Philistēi fullblīþe wǣron: þancodon hiera Gode, Dagon gehāten, swelce hīe þurh his fultum hiera fēond gewielden.
text_bare: And þa Philistei fullbliþe wæron: þancodon hiera Gode, Dagon gehaten, swelce hie þurh his fultum hiera feond gewielden.

text: Þā Philistēi þā micle feorme geworhton, and gesamnodon hīe on sumre ūp-flōra, ealle þā hēafod-menn, and ēac swelce wīf-menn, þrēo þūsend manna on micelre blisse.
text_bare: Þa Philistei þa micle feorme geworhton, and gesamnodon hie on sumre up-flora, ealle þa heafod-menn, and eac swelce wif-menn, þreo þusend manna on micelre blisse.

text: And þā þā hīe blīþost wǣron, þā bǣdon hīe sume þæt Samson mōste him macian sum gamen; and hine man sōna gefette mid swīþlicre wāfunge, and hēton hine standan betwix twǣm stǣnenum swēorum.
text_bare: And þa þa hie bliþost wæron, þa bædon hie sume þæt Samson moste him macian sum gamen; and hine man sona gefette mid swiþlicre wafunge, and heton hine standan betwix twæm stænenum sweorum.

text: On þǣm twǣm swēorum stōd þæt hūs eall geworht.
text_bare: On þæm twæm sweorum stod þæt hus eall geworht.

text: And Samson þā plegode swīþe him ætforan; and gelǣhte þā swēoras mid swīþlicre mihte, and slōg hīe tōgædre þæt hīe sōna tōburston; and þæt hūs þā āfēoll eall, þǣm folce tō dēaþe, and Samson forþ mid, swā þæt hē micle mā on his dēaþe ācwealde þonne hē ǣr cwic dyde.
text_bare: And Samson þa plegode swiþe him ætforan; and gelæhte þa sweoras mid swiþlicre mihte, and slog hie togædre þæt hie sona toburston; and þæt hus þa afeoll eall, þæm folce to deaþe, and Samson forþ mid, swa þæt he micle ma on his deaþe acwealde þonne he ær cwic dyde.

text: Breten īeg-land is eahta hund mīla lang, and twā hund mīla brād; and hēr sind on þǣm īeglande fīf geþēodu: Englisc, Brettisc, Scyttisc, Pihtisc, and Bōc-læden.
text_bare: Breten ieg-land is eahta hund mila lang, and twa hund mila brad; and her sind on þæm ieglande fif geþeodu: Englisc, Brettisc, Scyttisc, Pihtisc, and Boc-læden.

text: Ǣrest wǣron būend þisses landes Brettas.
text_bare: Ærest wæron buend þisses landes Brettas.

text: Þā cōmon of Armenia, and gesǣton sūþan-wearde Bretene ǣrest.
text_bare: Þa comon of Armenia, and gesæton suþan-wearde Bretene ærest.

text: Þā gelamp hit þæt Peohtas cōmon sūþan of Scithian mid langum scipum, nā manigum; and þā cōmon ǣrest on Norþ-ibernian ūp; and þǣr bǣdon Scottas þæt hīe þǣr mōsten wunian.
text_bare: Þa gelamp hit þæt Peohtas comon suþan of Scithian mid langum scipum, na manigum; and þa comon ærest on Norþ-ibernian up; and þær bædon Scottas þæt hie þær mosten wunian.

text: Ac hīe noldon him līefan, for þǣm þe hīe cwǣdon þæt hīe ne mihten ealle ætgædre gewunian þǣr.
text_bare: Ac hie noldon him liefan, for þæm þe hie cwædon þæt hie ne mihten ealle ætgædre gewunian þær.

text: And þā cwǣdon þā Scottas: 'Wē magon ēow hwæþre rǣd gelǣran: wē witon ōþer īegland hēr-beēastan; þǣr gē magon eardian, gif gē willaþ; and gif hwā ēow wiþstent, wē ēow fultumiaþ þæt gē hit mægen gegān.' Þā fērdon þā Peohtas, and gefērdon þis land norþan-weard; sūþan-weard hit hæfdon Brettas, swā swā wē ǣr cwǣdon.
text_bare: And þa cwædon þa Scottas: 'We magon eow hwæþre ræd gelæran: we witon oþer iegland her-beeastan; þær ge magon eardian, gif ge willaþ; and gif hwa eow wiþstent, we eow fultumiaþ þæt ge hit mægen gegan.' Þa ferdon þa Peohtas, and geferdon þis land norþan-weard; suþan-weard hit hæfdon Brettas, swa swa we ær cwædon.

text: And þā Peohtas him ābǣdon wīf æt Scottum on þā gerād þæt hīe gecuren hiera cyne-cynn ā on þā wīf-healfe.
text_bare: And þa Peohtas him abædon wif æt Scottum on þa gerad þæt hie gecuren hiera cyne-cynn a on þa wif-healfe.

text: Þæt hīe hēoldon swā lange siþþan.
text_bare: Þæt hie heoldon swa lange siþþan.

text: And þā gelamp ymbe gēara ryne þæt Scotta sum dǣl gewāt of Ibernian on Bretene, and þæs landes sumne dǣl geēodon; and wæs hiera here-toga Rēoda gehāten: fram þæm hīe sind genemnede Dālrēodi.
text_bare: And þa gelamp ymbe geara ryne þæt Scotta sum dæl gewat of Ibernian on Bretene, and þæs landes sumne dæl geeodon; and wæs hiera here-toga Reoda gehaten: fram þæm hie sind genemnede Dalreodi.

text: Anno .
text_bare: Anno .

text: Hēr Martiānus and Valentīnus onfēngon rīce, and rīcsodon seofon winter.
text_bare: Her Martianus and Valentinus onfengon rice, and ricsodon seofon winter.

text: And on hiera dagum, Hengest and Horsa, fram Wyrtgeorne gelaþode, Bretta cyninge, gesōhton Bretene on þǣm stede þe is genemned Ypwines-flēot, ǣrest Brettum tō fultume, ac hīe eft on hīe fuhton.
text_bare: And on hiera dagum, Hengest and Horsa, fram Wyrtgeorne gelaþode, Bretta cyninge, gesohton Bretene on þæm stede þe is genemned Ypwines-fleot, ærest Brettum to fultume, ac hie eft on hie fuhton.

text: Se cyning hēt hīe feohtan ongēan Peohtas; and hīe swā dydon, and sige hæfdon swā hwǣr swā hīe cōmon.
text_bare: Se cyning het hie feohtan ongean Peohtas; and hie swa dydon, and sige hæfdon swa hwær swa hie comon.

text: Hīe þā sendon tō Angle, and hēton him sendan māran fultum; and hēton him secgan Bret-wēala nāhtnesse and þæs landes cysta.
text_bare: Hie þa sendon to Angle, and heton him sendan maran fultum; and heton him secgan Bret-weala nahtnesse and þæs landes cysta.

text: Hīe þā sendon him māran fultum.
text_bare: Hie þa sendon him maran fultum.

text: Þā cōmon þā menn of þrim mǣgþum Germānie: of Eald-seaxum, of Englum, of Īotum.
text_bare: Þa comon þa menn of þrim mægþum Germanie: of Eald-seaxum, of Englum, of Iotum.

text: Of Īotum cōmon Cant-ware and Wiht-ware—þæt is sēo mǣgþ þe nū eardaþ on Wiht—and þæt cynn on West-seaxum þe man nūgiet hǣtt 'Īotena cynn.' Of Eald-seaxum cōmon Ēast-seaxe, and Sūþ-seaxe, and West-seaxe.
text_bare: Of Iotum comon Cant-ware and Wiht-ware—þæt is seo mægþ þe nu eardaþ on Wiht—and þæt cynn on West-seaxum þe man nugiet hætt 'Iotena cynn.' Of Eald-seaxum comon East-seaxe, and Suþ-seaxe, and West-seaxe.

text: Of Angle cōmon—sē ā siþþan stōd wēste betwix Īotum and Seaxum—Ēast-engle, Middel-engle, Mierce, and ealle Norþhymbre.
text_bare: Of Angle comon—se a siþþan stod weste betwix Iotum and Seaxum—East-engle, Middel-engle, Mierce, and ealle Norþhymbre.

text: Hēr Hengest and Horsa fuhton wiþ Wyrtgeorne þǣm cyninge in þǣre stōwe þe is gecweden Ægles-þrep; and his brōþor Horsan man ofslōg.
text_bare: Her Hengest and Horsa fuhton wiþ Wyrtgeorne þæm cyninge in þære stowe þe is gecweden Ægles-þrep; and his broþor Horsan man ofslog.

text: And æfter þǣm Hengest fēng tō rīce, and Æsc his sunu.
text_bare: And æfter þæm Hengest feng to rice, and Æsc his sunu.

text: Hēr Hengest and Æsc fuhton wiþ Brettas in þǣre stōwe þe is gecweden Crecgan-ford, and þǣr ofslōgon fēower þūsend wera.
text_bare: Her Hengest and Æsc fuhton wiþ Brettas in þære stowe þe is gecweden Crecgan-ford, and þær ofslogon feower þusend wera.

text: And þā Brettas þā forlēton Cent-land, and mid micle ege flugon tō Lunden-byrig.
text_bare: And þa Brettas þa forleton Cent-land, and mid micle ege flugon to Lunden-byrig.

text: Hēr Hengest and Æsc gefuhton wiþ Wēalas, and genāmon un-ārīmedlicu here-rēaf, and þā Wēalas flugon þā Engle swā swā fȳr.
text_bare: Her Hengest and Æsc gefuhton wiþ Wealas, and genamon un-arimedlicu here-reaf, and þa Wealas flugon þa Engle swa swa fyr.

text: Hēr nam Beorht-rīc cyning Offan dohtor Ēad-burge.
text_bare: Her nam Beorht-ric cyning Offan dohtor Ead-burge.

text: And on his dagum cōmon ǣrest þrēo scipu; and þā se gerēfa þǣr tō rād, and hīe wolde drīfan tō þæs cyninges tūne, þȳ hē nyste hwæt hīe wǣron; and hine man ofslōg.
text_bare: And on his dagum comon ærest þreo scipu; and þa se gerefa þær to rad, and hie wolde drifan to þæs cyninges tune, þy he nyste hwæt hie wæron; and hine man ofslog.

text: Þæt wǣron þā ǣrestan scipu Deniscra manna þe Angel-cynnes land gesōhton.
text_bare: Þæt wæron þa ærestan scipu Deniscra manna þe Angel-cynnes land gesohton.

text: Hēr Ceorl ealdor-mann gefeaht wiþ hǣþne menn mid Defena-scīre æt Wicgan-beorge, and þǣr micel wæl geslōgon, and sige nāmon.
text_bare: Her Ceorl ealdor-mann gefeaht wiþ hæþne menn mid Defena-scire æt Wicgan-beorge, and þær micel wæl geslogon, and sige namon.

text: And þȳ ilcan gēare Æþelstān cyning and Ealhhere dux micelne here ofslōgon æt Sand-wīc on Cent; and nigon scipu gefēngon, and þā ōþru geflīemdon; and hǣþne menn ǣrest ofer winter sǣton.
text_bare: And þy ilcan geare Æþelstan cyning and Ealhhere dux micelne here ofslogon æt Sand-wic on Cent; and nigon scipu gefengon, and þa oþru gefliemdon; and hæþne menn ærest ofer winter sæton.
