text: And þȳ ilcan gēare cōm fēorþe healf hund scipa on Temese-mūþan, and brǣcon Cantwara-burg, and Lunden-burg, and geflīemdon Beorhtwulf Miercna cyning mid his fierde; and fērdon þā sūþ ofer Temese on Sūþrige; and him gefeaht wiþ Æþelwulf cyning and Æþelbeald his sunu æt Āc-lēa mid West-seaxna fierde, and þǣr þæt mǣste wæl geslōgon on hǣþnum here þe wē secgan hīerdon oþ þisne andweardan dæg, and þǣr sige nāmon.
text_bare: And þy ilcan geare com feorþe healf hund scipa on Temese-muþan, and bræcon Cantwara-burg, and Lunden-burg, and gefliemdon Beorhtwulf Miercna cyning mid his fierde; and ferdon þa suþ ofer Temese on Suþrige; and him gefeaht wiþ Æþelwulf cyning and Æþelbeald his sunu æt Ac-lea mid West-seaxna fierde, and þær þæt mæste wæl geslogon on hæþnum here þe we secgan hierdon oþ þisne andweardan dæg, and þær sige namon.

text: Hēr fōr se here of Ēast-englum ofer Humbre-mūþan tō Eoforwīc-ceastre on Norþ-hymbre.
text_bare: Her for se here of East-englum ofer Humbre-muþan to Eoforwic-ceastre on Norþ-hymbre.

text: And þǣr wæs micel un-geþwǣrnes þǣre þēode betwix him selfum, and hīe hæfdon hiera cyning āworpenne Ōsbryht, and un-gecyndne cyning underfēngon Ællan.
text_bare: And þær wæs micel un-geþwærnes þære þeode betwix him selfum, and hie hæfdon hiera cyning aworpenne Osbryht, and un-gecyndne cyning underfengon Ællan.

text: And hīe late on gēare tō þǣm gecierdon þæt hīe wiþ þone here winnende wǣron; and hīe þēah micle fierd gegadrodon, and þone here sōhton æt Eoforwīc-ceastre; and on þā ceastre brǣcon, and hīe sume inne wurdon; and þǣr wæs un-gemetlic wæl geslægen Norþanhymbra, sume binnan, sume būtan, and þā cyningas bēgen ofslægene; and sēo lāf wiþ þone here friþ nam.
text_bare: And hie late on geare to þæm gecierdon þæt hie wiþ þone here winnende wæron; and hie þeah micle fierd gegadrodon, and þone here sohton æt Eoforwic-ceastre; and on þa ceastre bræcon, and hie sume inne wurdon; and þær wæs un-gemetlic wæl geslægen Norþanhymbra, sume binnan, sume butan, and þa cyningas begen ofslægene; and seo laf wiþ þone here friþ nam.

text: Sum swīþe gelǣred munuc cōm sūþan ofer sǣ fram sancte Benedictes stōwe, on Æþelredes cyninges dæge, to Dūnstāne ærce-biscope, þrim gēarum ǣr þǣm þe hē forþfērde, and se munuc hātte Abbo.
text_bare: Sum swiþe gelæred munuc com suþan ofer sæ fram sancte Benedictes stowe, on Æþelredes cyninges dæge, to Dunstane ærce-biscope, þrim gearum ær þæm þe he forþferde, and se munuc hatte Abbo.

text: Þā wurdon hīe æt sprǣce, oþ þæt Dūnstān reahte be sancte Ēadmunde, swā swā Ēadmundes sweord-bora hit reahte Æþelstāne cyninge, þā þā Dūnstān gēong mann wæs, and se sweord-bora wæs forealdod mann.
text_bare: Þa wurdon hie æt spræce, oþ þæt Dunstan reahte be sancte Eadmunde, swa swa Eadmundes sweord-bora hit reahte Æþelstane cyninge, þa þa Dunstan geong mann wæs, and se sweord-bora wæs forealdod mann.

text: Þā gesette se munuc ealle þā, gerecednesse on ānre bēc, and eft, þā þā sēo bōc cōm tō ūs, binnan fēam gēarum, þā āwendon wē hit on Englisc, swā swā hit hēræfter stent.
text_bare: Þa gesette se munuc ealle þa, gerecednesse on anre bec, and eft, þa þa seo boc com to us, binnan feam gearum, þa awendon we hit on Englisc, swa swa hit heræfter stent.

text: Se munuc þā Abbo binnan twǣm gēarum gewende hām tō his mynstre, and wearþ sōna tō abbode gesett on þǣm ilcan mynstre.
text_bare: Se munuc þa Abbo binnan twæm gearum gewende ham to his mynstre, and wearþ sona to abbode gesett on þæm ilcan mynstre.

text: Ēadmund se ēadiga, Ēast-engla cyning, wæs snotor and weorþfull, and weorþode simle mid æþelum þēawum þone ælmihtigan God.
text_bare: Eadmund se eadiga, East-engla cyning, wæs snotor and weorþfull, and weorþode simle mid æþelum þeawum þone ælmihtigan God.

text: Hē wæs ēaþ-mōd and geþungen, and swā ān-rǣd þurhwunode þæt hē nolde ābūgan tō bismerfullum leahtrum, ne on nāwþre healfe hē ne āhielde his þēawas, ac wæs simle gemyndig þǣre sōþan lāre: 'Gif þū eart tō hēafod-menn gesett, ne āhefe þū þē, ac bēo betwix mannum swā swā ān mann of him.' Hē wæs cystig wǣdlum and widewum swā swā fæder, and mid wel-willendnesse gewissode his folc simle tō riht-wīsnesse, and þǣm rēþum stīerde, and gesǣliglīce leofode on sōþum gelēafan.
text_bare: He wæs eaþ-mod and geþungen, and swa an-ræd þurhwunode þæt he nolde abugan to bismerfullum leahtrum, ne on nawþre healfe he ne ahielde his þeawas, ac wæs simle gemyndig þære soþan lare: 'Gif þu eart to heafod-menn gesett, ne ahefe þu þe, ac beo betwix mannum swa swa an mann of him.' He wæs cystig wædlum and widewum swa swa fæder, and mid wel-willendnesse gewissode his folc simle to riht-wisnesse, and þæm reþum stierde, and gesæliglice leofode on soþum geleafan.

text: Hit gelamp þā æt nīehstan þæt þā Deniscan lēode fērdon mid scip-here, hergiende and slēande wīde geond land, swā swā hiera gewuna is.
text_bare: Hit gelamp þa æt niehstan þæt þa Deniscan leode ferdon mid scip-here, hergiende and sleande wide geond land, swa swa hiera gewuna is.

text: On þǣm flotan wǣron þā fyrmestan hēafod-menn, Hinguar and Hubba, geānlǣhte þurh dēofol, and hīe on Norþhymbra-lande gelendon mid æscum, and āwēston þæt land, and þā lēode ofslōgon.
text_bare: On þæm flotan wæron þa fyrmestan heafod-menn, Hinguar and Hubba, geanlæhte þurh deofol, and hie on Norþhymbra-lande gelendon mid æscum, and aweston þæt land, and þa leode ofslogon.

text: Þā gewende Hinguar ēast mid his scipum, and Hubba belāf on Norþhymbra-lande, gewunnenum sige mid wæl-hrēownesse.
text_bare: Þa gewende Hinguar east mid his scipum, and Hubba belaf on Norþhymbra-lande, gewunnenum sige mid wæl-hreownesse.

text: Hinguar þā becōm tō Ēast-englum rōwende on þǣm gēare þe Ælfred æþeling ān and twentig gēara wæs, sē þe West-seaxna cyning siþþan wearþ mǣre.
text_bare: Hinguar þa becom to East-englum rowende on þæm geare þe Ælfred æþeling an and twentig geara wæs, se þe West-seaxna cyning siþþan wearþ mære.

text: And se fore-sægda Hinguar fǣrlīce, swā swā wulf, on lande bestealcode, and þā lēode slōg, weras and wīf, and þā ungewittigan cīld, and to bismere tūcode þā bilewītan Crīstenan.
text_bare: And se fore-sægda Hinguar færlice, swa swa wulf, on lande bestealcode, and þa leode slog, weras and wif, and þa ungewittigan cild, and to bismere tucode þa bilewitan Cristenan.

text: Hē sende þā siþþan sōna tō þǣm cyninge bēotlic ǣrende, þæt hē ābūgan scolde tō his mann-rǣdenne, gif hē his fēores rōhte.
text_bare: He sende þa siþþan sona to þæm cyninge beotlic ærende, þæt he abugan scolde to his mann-rædenne, gif he his feores rohte.

text: Se ǣrend-raca cōm þā tō Ēadmunde cyninge, and Hinguares ǣrende him arodlīce ābēad: 'Hinguar ūre cyning, cēne and sigefæst on sǣ and on lande, hæfþ fela þēoda geweald, and cōm nū mid fierde fǣrlīce hēr tō lande, þæt hē hēr winter-setl mid his werode hæbbe.
text_bare: Se ærend-raca com þa to Eadmunde cyninge, and Hinguares ærende him arodlice abead: 'Hinguar ure cyning, cene and sigefæst on sæ and on lande, hæfþ fela þeoda geweald, and com nu mid fierde færlice her to lande, þæt he her winter-setl mid his werode hæbbe.

text: Nū hǣtt hē þē dǣlan þīne dīeglan gold-hordas and þīnra ieldrena gestrēon arodlīce wiþ hine, and þū bēo his under-cyning, gif þū cwic bēon wilt, for þǣm þe þū næfst þā miht þæt þū mæge him wiþstandan.' Hwæt þā Ēadmund cyning clipode ānne biscop þe him þā gehendost wæs, and wiþ hine smēade hū hē þǣm rēþan Hinguare andwyrdan scolde.
text_bare: Nu hætt he þe dælan þine dieglan gold-hordas and þinra ieldrena gestreon arodlice wiþ hine, and þu beo his under-cyning, gif þu cwic beon wilt, for þæm þe þu næfst þa miht þæt þu mæge him wiþstandan.' Hwæt þa Eadmund cyning clipode anne biscop þe him þa gehendost wæs, and wiþ hine smeade hu he þæm reþan Hinguare andwyrdan scolde.

text: Þā forhtode se biscop for þǣm fǣrlican gelimpe, and for þæs cyninges līfe, and cwæþ þæt him rǣd þūhte þæt hē tō þǣm gebuge þe him bēad Hinguar.
text_bare: Þa forhtode se biscop for þæm færlican gelimpe, and for þæs cyninges life, and cwæþ þæt him ræd þuhte þæt he to þæm gebuge þe him bead Hinguar.

text: Þā swīgode se cyning, and beseah tō þǣre eorþan, and cwæþ þā æt nīehstan cynelīce him tō: 'Ēalā þū biscop, tō bismere sind getāwode þās earman land-lēode, and mē nū lēofre wǣre þæt ic on gefeohte fēolle wiþ þǣm þe mīn folc mōste hiera eardes brūcan.' And se biscop cwæþ: 'Ēalā þū lēofa cyning, þīn folc līþ ofslægen, and þū næfst þone fultum þæt þū feohtan mæge, and þās flot-menn cumaþ, and þē cwicne gebindaþ, būtan þū mid flēame þīnum fēore gebeorge, oþþe þū þē swā gebeorge þæt þū būge tō him.' Þā cwæþ Ēadmund cyning, swā swā hē fullcēne wæs: 'þæs ic gewilnige and gewȳsce mid mōde þæt ic āna ne belīfe æfter mīnum lēofum þegnum, þe on hiera beddum wurdon mid bearnum and wīfum fǣrlīce ofslægene fram þissum flot-mannum.
text_bare: Þa swigode se cyning, and beseah to þære eorþan, and cwæþ þa æt niehstan cynelice him to: 'Eala þu biscop, to bismere sind getawode þas earman land-leode, and me nu leofre wære þæt ic on gefeohte feolle wiþ þæm þe min folc moste hiera eardes brucan.' And se biscop cwæþ: 'Eala þu leofa cyning, þin folc liþ ofslægen, and þu næfst þone fultum þæt þu feohtan mæge, and þas flot-menn cumaþ, and þe cwicne gebindaþ, butan þu mid fleame þinum feore gebeorge, oþþe þu þe swa gebeorge þæt þu buge to him.' Þa cwæþ Eadmund cyning, swa swa he fullcene wæs: 'þæs ic gewilnige and gewysce mid mode þæt ic ana ne belife æfter minum leofum þegnum, þe on hiera beddum wurdon mid bearnum and wifum færlice ofslægene fram þissum flot-mannum.

text: Næs mē nǣfre gewunelic þæt ic worhte flēames, ac ic wolde swīþor sweltan, gif ic þorfte, for mīnum āgnum earde, and se ælmihtiga God wāt þæt ic nyle ābūgan fram his bī-gengum ǣfre, ne fram his sōþre lufe, swelte ic, libbe ic.' Æfter þissum wordum hē gewende tō þǣm ǣrend-racan þe Hinguar him tō sende, and sægde him unforht: 'Witodlīce þū wǣre nū wierþe sleges, ac ic nyle āfȳlan on þīnum fūlum blōde mīne clǣnan handa, for þǣm þe ic Crīste folgige, þe ūs swā gebȳsnode; ac ic blīþelīce wile bēon ofslægen þurh ēow, gif hit swā God fore-scēawaþ.
text_bare: Næs me næfre gewunelic þæt ic worhte fleames, ac ic wolde swiþor sweltan, gif ic þorfte, for minum agnum earde, and se ælmihtiga God wat þæt ic nyle abugan fram his bi-gengum æfre, ne fram his soþre lufe, swelte ic, libbe ic.' Æfter þissum wordum he gewende to þæm ærend-racan þe Hinguar him to sende, and sægde him unforht: 'Witodlice þu wære nu wierþe sleges, ac ic nyle afylan on þinum fulum blode mine clænan handa, for þæm þe ic Criste folgige, þe us swa gebysnode; ac ic bliþelice wile beon ofslægen þurh eow, gif hit swa God fore-sceawaþ.

text: Far nū swīþe hraþe, and sege þīnum rēþan hlāforde, "ne ābȳhþ nǣfre Ēadmund Hinguare on līfe, hǣþnum here-togan, būtan hē to Hǣlende Crīste ǣrest mid gelēafan on þissum lande gebūge."' Þā gewende se ǣrend-raca arodlīce onweg, and gemētte be wege þone wæl-hrēowan Hinguar mid ealre his fierde fūse to Ēadmunde, and sægde þǣm ārleasan hū him geandwyrd wæs.
text_bare: Far nu swiþe hraþe, and sege þinum reþan hlaforde, "ne abyhþ næfre Eadmund Hinguare on life, hæþnum here-togan, butan he to Hælende Criste ærest mid geleafan on þissum lande gebuge."' Þa gewende se ærend-raca arodlice onweg, and gemette be wege þone wæl-hreowan Hinguar mid ealre his fierde fuse to Eadmunde, and sægde þæm arleasan hu him geandwyrd wæs.

text: Hinguar bebēad þā mid bieldo þǣm scip-here þæt hīe þæs cyninges ānes ealle cēpan scolden, þe his hǣse forseah, and hine sōna bindan.
text_bare: Hinguar bebead þa mid bieldo þæm scip-here þæt hie þæs cyninges anes ealle cepan scolden, þe his hæse forseah, and hine sona bindan.

text: Hwæt þā Ēadmund cyning, mid þǣm þe Hinguar cōm, stōd innan his healle, þæs Hǣlendes gemyndig, and āwearp his wǣpnu: wolde geefenlǣcan Crīstes gebȳsnungum, þe forbēad Petre mid wǣpnum tō winnenne wiþ þā wælhrēowan Iūdēiscan.
text_bare: Hwæt þa Eadmund cyning, mid þæm þe Hinguar com, stod innan his healle, þæs Hælendes gemyndig, and awearp his wæpnu: wolde geefenlæcan Cristes gebysnungum, þe forbead Petre mid wæpnum to winnenne wiþ þa wælhreowan Iudeiscan.

text: Hwæt þā ārlēasan þā Ēadmund gebundon, and gebismrodon huxlīce, and bēoton mid sāglum, and swā siþþan lǣddon þone gelēaffullan cyning tō ānum eorþ-faestan trēowe, and tīegdon hine þǣr-tō mid heardum bendum, and hine eft swungon langlīce mid swipum; and hē simle clipode betwix þǣm swinglum mid sōþum gelēafan tō Hǣlende Crīste; and þā hǣþnan þā for his gelēafan wurdon wōdlīce ierre, for þǣm þe hē clipode Crīst him tō fultume: hīe scuton þā mid gafelocum him tō, swelce him to gamene, oþ þæt hē eall wæs besett mid hiera scotungum, swelce īles byrsta, swā swā Sebastiānus wæs.
text_bare: Hwæt þa arleasan þa Eadmund gebundon, and gebismrodon huxlice, and beoton mid saglum, and swa siþþan læddon þone geleaffullan cyning to anum eorþ-faestan treowe, and tiegdon hine þær-to mid heardum bendum, and hine eft swungon langlice mid swipum; and he simle clipode betwix þæm swinglum mid soþum geleafan to Hælende Criste; and þa hæþnan þa for his geleafan wurdon wodlice ierre, for þæm þe he clipode Crist him to fultume: hie scuton þa mid gafelocum him to, swelce him to gamene, oþ þæt he eall wæs besett mid hiera scotungum, swelce iles byrsta, swa swa Sebastianus wæs.

text: Þā geseah Hinguar, se ārlēasa flotmann, þæt se æþela cyning nolde Crīste wiþsacan, ac mid ānrǣdum gelēafan hine ǣfre clipode: hēt hine þā behēafdian, and þā hǣþnan swā dydon.
text_bare: Þa geseah Hinguar, se arleasa flotmann, þæt se æþela cyning nolde Criste wiþsacan, ac mid anrædum geleafan hine æfre clipode: het hine þa beheafdian, and þa hæþnan swa dydon.

text: Betwix þǣm þe hē clipode tō Crīste þāgiet, þā tugon þā hǣþnan þone hālgan tō slege, and mid ānum swenge slōgon him of þæt hēafod, and his sāwol sīþode gesǣlig tō Crīste.
text_bare: Betwix þæm þe he clipode to Criste þagiet, þa tugon þa hæþnan þone halgan to slege, and mid anum swenge slogon him of þæt heafod, and his sawol siþode gesælig to Criste.

text: Þǣr wæs sum mann gehende gehealden, þurh God behȳdd þǣm hǣþnum, þe þis gehīerde eall, and hit eft sægde, swā swā wē hit secgaþ hēr.
text_bare: Þær wæs sum mann gehende gehealden, þurh God behydd þæm hæþnum, þe þis gehierde eall, and hit eft sægde, swa swa we hit secgaþ her.

text: Hwæt þā se flot-here fērde eft tō scipe, and behȳddon þæt hēafod þæs hālgan Ēadmundes on þǣm þiccum brēmlum, þæt hit bebyrged ne wurde.
text_bare: Hwæt þa se flot-here ferde eft to scipe, and behyddon þæt heafod þæs halgan Eadmundes on þæm þiccum bremlum, þæt hit bebyrged ne wurde.

text: Þā æfter fierste siþþan hīe āfarene wǣron, cōm þæt land-folc tō, þe þǣr tō lāfe wæs, þǣr hiera hlāfordes līc læg būtan hēafde, and wurdon swiþe sārige for his slege on mōde, and hūru þæt hīe næfden þæt hēafod tō þǣm bodige.
text_bare: Þa æfter fierste siþþan hie afarene wæron, com þæt land-folc to, þe þær to lafe wæs, þær hiera hlafordes lic læg butan heafde, and wurdon swiþe sarige for his slege on mode, and huru þæt hie næfden þæt heafod to þæm bodige.

text: Þā sægde se scēawere þe hit ǣr geseah, þæt þā flotmenn hæfden þæt hēafod mid him; and wæs him geþūht, swā swā hit wæs fullsōþ, þæt hīe behȳdden þæt hēafod on þǣm holte forhwega.
text_bare: Þa sægde se sceawere þe hit ær geseah, þæt þa flotmenn hæfden þæt heafod mid him; and wæs him geþuht, swa swa hit wæs fullsoþ, þæt hie behydden þæt heafod on þæm holte forhwega.

text: Hīe ēodon þā endemes ealle tō þǣm wuda, sēcende gehwǣr, geond þȳflas and brēmlas, gif hīe ā-hwǣr mihten gemētan þæt hēafod.
text_bare: Hie eodon þa endemes ealle to þæm wuda, secende gehwær, geond þyflas and bremlas, gif hie a-hwær mihten gemetan þæt heafod.

text: Wæs ēac micel wundor þæt ān wulf wearþ āsend, þurh Godes wissunge, tō bewerienne þæt hēafod wiþ þā ōþru dēor ofer dæg and niht.
text_bare: Wæs eac micel wundor þæt an wulf wearþ asend, þurh Godes wissunge, to bewerienne þæt heafod wiþ þa oþru deor ofer dæg and niht.

text: Hīe ēodon þā sēcende and simle clipiende, swā swā hit gewunelic is þǣm þe on wuda gāþ oft, 'hwǣr eart þū nū, gefēra?' And him andwyrde þæt hēafod, 'hēr, hēr, hēr;' and swā gelōme clipode andswariende him eallum, swā oft swā hiera ǣnig clipode, oþ þæt hīe ealle becōmon þurh þā clipunge him tō.
text_bare: Hie eodon þa secende and simle clipiende, swa swa hit gewunelic is þæm þe on wuda gaþ oft, 'hwær eart þu nu, gefera?' And him andwyrde þæt heafod, 'her, her, her;' and swa gelome clipode andswariende him eallum, swa oft swa hiera ænig clipode, oþ þæt hie ealle becomon þurh þa clipunge him to.

text: Þā læg se grǣga wulf þe bewiste þæt hēafod, and mid his twǣm fōtum hæfde þæt hēafod beclypped, grǣdig and hungrig, and for Gode ne dorste þæs hēafdes onbyrgan, ac hēold hit wiþ dēor.
text_bare: Þa læg se græga wulf þe bewiste þæt heafod, and mid his twæm fotum hæfde þæt heafod beclypped, grædig and hungrig, and for Gode ne dorste þæs heafdes onbyrgan, ac heold hit wiþ deor.

text: Þā wurdon hīe ofwundrode þæs wulfes hierd-rǣdenne, and þæt hālige hēafod hām feredon mid him, þanciende þǣm Ælmihtigan ealra his wundra.
text_bare: Þa wurdon hie ofwundrode þæs wulfes hierd-rædenne, and þæt halige heafod ham feredon mid him, þanciende þæm Ælmihtigan ealra his wundra.

text: Ac se wulf folgode forþ mid þǣm hēafde, oþ þæt hīe tō tūne cōmon, swelce hē tam wære, and gewende eft siþþan tō wuda ongēan.
text_bare: Ac se wulf folgode forþ mid þæm heafde, oþ þæt hie to tune comon, swelce he tam wære, and gewende eft siþþan to wuda ongean.

text: Þā land-lēode þā siþþan legdon þæt hēafod tō þǣm hālgan bodige, and bebyrigdon swā hīe sēlest mihton on swelcre hrædunge, and cirican ārǣrdon sōna him onuppan.
text_bare: Þa land-leode þa siþþan legdon þæt heafod to þæm halgan bodige, and bebyrigdon swa hie selest mihton on swelcre hrædunge, and cirican arærdon sona him onuppan.

text: Eft þā on fierste, æfter fela gēarum, þā sēo hergung geswāc, and sibb wearþ forgiefen þǣm geswenctan folce, þā fēngon hīe tōgædre, and worhton āne cirican weorþlīce þǣm hālgan, for þǣm þe gelōme wundru wurdon æt his byrgenne, æt þǣm gebed-hūse þǣr hē bebyrged wæs.
text_bare: Eft þa on fierste, æfter fela gearum, þa seo hergung geswac, and sibb wearþ forgiefen þæm geswenctan folce, þa fengon hie togædre, and worhton ane cirican weorþlice þæm halgan, for þæm þe gelome wundru wurdon æt his byrgenne, æt þæm gebed-huse þær he bebyrged wæs.

text: Hīe woldon þā ferian mid folclicre weorþmynde þone hālgan līchaman, and lecgan innan þǣre cirican.
text_bare: Hie woldon þa ferian mid folclicre weorþmynde þone halgan lichaman, and lecgan innan þære cirican.

text: Þā wæs micel wundor þæt hē wæs eall swā gehāl swelce hē cwic wǣre, mid clǣnum līchaman, and his swēora wæs gehǣled, þe ǣr wæs forslægen, and wæs swelce ān seolcen þrǣd ymbe his swēoran, mannum tō sweotolunge hū hē ofslægen wæs.
text_bare: Þa wæs micel wundor þæt he wæs eall swa gehal swelce he cwic wære, mid clænum lichaman, and his sweora wæs gehæled, þe ær wæs forslægen, and wæs swelce an seolcen þræd ymbe his sweoran, mannum to sweotolunge hu he ofslægen wæs.

text: Ēac swelce þā wunda, þe þā wælhrēowan hǣþnan mid gelōmum scotungum on his līce macodon, wǣron gehǣlde þurh þone heofonlican God; and hē; līþ swā onsund oþ þisne and-weardan dæg, and-bīdiende ǣristes and þæs ēcan wuldres.
text_bare: Eac swelce þa wunda, þe þa wælhreowan hæþnan mid gelomum scotungum on his lice macodon, wæron gehælde þurh þone heofonlican God; and he; liþ swa onsund oþ þisne and-weardan dæg, and-bidiende æristes and þæs ecan wuldres.

text: His līchama ūs cȳþþ, þe līþ un-formolsnod, þæt hē būtan forligre hēr on worulde leofode, and mid clǣnum līfe tō; Crīste sīþode.
text_bare: His lichama us cyþþ, þe liþ un-formolsnod, þæt he butan forligre her on worulde leofode, and mid clænum life to; Criste siþode.

text: Sum widewe wunode, Ōswyn gehāten, æt þæs hālgan byrgenne, on gebedum and fæstennum manigu gēar siþþan.
text_bare: Sum widewe wunode, Oswyn gehaten, æt þæs halgan byrgenne, on gebedum and fæstennum manigu gear siþþan.

text: Sēo wolde efsian ǣlce gēare þone sanct, and his næglas ceorfan sīeferlīce mid lufe, and on scrīne healdan tō hālig-dōme on weofode.
text_bare: Seo wolde efsian ælce geare þone sanct, and his næglas ceorfan sieferlice mid lufe, and on scrine healdan to halig-dome on weofode.

text: Þa weorþode þæt land-folc mid gelēafan þone sanct, and Þēodred biscop þearle mid giefum on golde and on seolfre, þǣm sancte tō weorþmynde.
text_bare: Þa weorþode þæt land-folc mid geleafan þone sanct, and Þeodred biscop þearle mid giefum on golde and on seolfre, þæm sancte to weorþmynde.

text: Þā cōmon on sumne sǣl un-gesǣlige þēofas eahta on ānre nihte tō þǣm ār-weorþan hālgan: woldon stelan þā māþmas þe menn þider brōhton, and cunnodon mid cræfte hū hīe inn cuman mihten.
text_bare: Þa comon on sumne sæl un-gesælige þeofas eahta on anre nihte to þæm ar-weorþan halgan: woldon stelan þa maþmas þe menn þider brohton, and cunnodon mid cræfte hu hie inn cuman mihten.

text: Sum slōg mid slecge swīþe þā hæspan, sum hiera mid fēolan fēolode ymbūtan, sum ēac underdealf þā duru mid spadan, sum hiera mid hlǣddre wolde onlūcan þǣt ēag-þȳrel; ac hīe swuncon on īdel, and earmlīce fērdon, swā þæt se hālga wer hīe wundorlīce geband, ǣlcne swā hē stōd strūtiendne mid tōle, þæt hiera nān ne mihte þæt morþ gefremman ne hīe þanon āstyrian; ac stōdon swā oþ mergen.
text_bare: Sum slog mid slecge swiþe þa hæspan, sum hiera mid feolan feolode ymbutan, sum eac underdealf þa duru mid spadan, sum hiera mid hlæddre wolde onlucan þæt eag-þyrel; ac hie swuncon on idel, and earmlice ferdon, swa þæt se halga wer hie wundorlice geband, ælcne swa he stod strutiendne mid tole, þæt hiera nan ne mihte þæt morþ gefremman ne hie þanon astyrian; ac stodon swa oþ mergen.

text: Menn þā þæs wundrodon, hū þā weargas hangodon, sum on hlǣddre, sum lēat tō gedelfe, and ǣlc on his weorce wæs fæste gebunden.
text_bare: Menn þa þæs wundrodon, hu þa weargas hangodon, sum on hlæddre, sum leat to gedelfe, and ælc on his weorce wæs fæste gebunden.

text: Hīe wurdon þā gebrōhte tō þǣm biscope ealle, and hē hēt hīe āhōn on hēam gealgum ealle; ac hē næs nā gemyndig hū se mildheorta God clipode þurh his wītegan þās word þe hēr standaþ: Eos qui ducuntur ad mortem eruere ne cesses, 'þā þe man lǣtt tō dēaþe ālīes hīe ūt simle.' And ēac þā hālgan canōnes bēc gehādodum forbēodaþ ge biscopum ge prēostum tō bēonne ymbe þēofas, for þǣm þe hit ne gebyreþ þǣm þe bēop gecorene Gode to þegnienne þæt hīe geþwǣrlǣcan scylen on ǣniges mannes dēaþe, gif hīe bēoþ Dryhtnes þegnas.
text_bare: Hie wurdon þa gebrohte to þæm biscope ealle, and he het hie ahon on heam gealgum ealle; ac he næs na gemyndig hu se mildheorta God clipode þurh his witegan þas word þe her standaþ: Eos qui ducuntur ad mortem eruere ne cesses, 'þa þe man lætt to deaþe alies hie ut simle.' And eac þa halgan canones bec gehadodum forbeodaþ ge biscopum ge preostum to beonne ymbe þeofas, for þæm þe hit ne gebyreþ þæm þe beop gecorene Gode to þegnienne þæt hie geþwærlæcan scylen on æniges mannes deaþe, gif hie beoþ Dryhtnes þegnas.

text: Eft þā Þēodred biscop scēawode his bēc, hē siþþan behrēowsode mid gēomrunge þæt hē swā rēþne dōm sette þǣm ungesǣligum þēofum, and hit besārgode ǣfre oþ his līfes ende, and þā lēode bæd georne þæt hīe him mid fæsten fullīce þrīe dagas, biddende þone Ælmihtigan þæt hē him ārian scolde.
text_bare: Eft þa Þeodred biscop sceawode his bec, he siþþan behreowsode mid geomrunge þæt he swa reþne dom sette þæm ungesæligum þeofum, and hit besargode æfre oþ his lifes ende, and þa leode bæd georne þæt hie him mid fæsten fullice þrie dagas, biddende þone Ælmihtigan þæt he him arian scolde.

text: On þǣm lande wæs sum mann, Lēofstān gehāten, rīce for worulde, un-gewittig for Gode; sē rād tō þǣm hālgan mid rīcetere swīþe, and hēt him ætīewan orgellīce swīþe þone hālgan sanct, hwæþer hē gesund wǣre; ac swā hraþe swā hē geseah þæs sanctes līchaman, þā āwēdde hē sōna, and wæl-hrēowlīce grymetode, and earmlīce geendode yflum dēaþe.
text_bare: On þæm lande wæs sum mann, Leofstan gehaten, rice for worulde, un-gewittig for Gode; se rad to þæm halgan mid ricetere swiþe, and het him ætiewan orgellice swiþe þone halgan sanct, hwæþer he gesund wære; ac swa hraþe swa he geseah þæs sanctes lichaman, þa awedde he sona, and wæl-hreowlice grymetode, and earmlice geendode yflum deaþe.

text: Þis is þǣm gelīc þe se gelēaffulla pāpa Gregōrius sægde on his gesetnesse be þǣm hālgan Laurentie, þe līþ on Rōme-byrig, þæt menn wolden scēawian hū hē lǣge ge gōde ge yfle; ac God hīe gestilde swā þæt þǣr swulton on þǣre scēawunge seofon menn ætgædre; þā geswicon þā ōþre tō scēawienne þone martyr mid menniscum gedwylde.
text_bare: Þis is þæm gelic þe se geleaffulla papa Gregorius sægde on his gesetnesse be þæm halgan Laurentie, þe liþ on Rome-byrig, þæt menn wolden sceawian hu he læge ge gode ge yfle; ac God hie gestilde swa þæt þær swulton on þære sceawunge seofon menn ætgædre; þa geswicon þa oþre to sceawienne þone martyr mid menniscum gedwylde.

text: Fela wundra wē gehīerdon on folclicre sprǣce be þǣm hālgan Ēadmunde, þe wē hēr nyllaþ on gewrite settan, ac hīe wāt gehwā.
text_bare: Fela wundra we gehierdon on folclicre spræce be þæm halgan Eadmunde, þe we her nyllaþ on gewrite settan, ac hie wat gehwa.

text: On þissum hālgan is sweotol, and on swelcum ōþrum, þæt God ælmihtig mæg þone mann ārǣran eft on dōmes dæge onsundne of eorþan, sē þe hielt Ēadmund hālne his līchaman oþ þone mīclan dæg, þēah þe hē on moldan cōme.
text_bare: On þissum halgan is sweotol, and on swelcum oþrum, þæt God ælmihtig mæg þone mann aræran eft on domes dæge onsundne of eorþan, se þe hielt Eadmund halne his lichaman oþ þone miclan dæg, þeah þe he on moldan come.

text: Wierþe wǣre sēo stōw for þǣm weorþfullan hālgan þæt hīe man weorþode and wel gelōgode mid clǣnum Godes þēowum tō Crīstes þēowdōme; for þǣm þe se hālga is mǣrra þonne menn mægen āsmēan.
text_bare: Wierþe wære seo stow for þæm weorþfullan halgan þæt hie man weorþode and wel gelogode mid clænum Godes þeowum to Cristes þeowdome; for þæm þe se halga is mærra þonne menn mægen asmean.

text: Nis Angel-cynn bedǣled Dryhtnes hālgena, þonne on Engla-lande licgaþ swelce hālgan swelce þes hālga cyning, and Cūþberht se ēadiga and sancte Æþelþrȳþ on Ēlig, and ēac hiere sweostor, onsund on līchaman, gelēafan tō trymmunge.
text_bare: Nis Angel-cynn bedæled Dryhtnes halgena, þonne on Engla-lande licgaþ swelce halgan swelce þes halga cyning, and Cuþberht se eadiga and sancte Æþelþryþ on Elig, and eac hiere sweostor, onsund on lichaman, geleafan to trymmunge.

text: Sind ēac fela ōþre on Angel-cynne hālgan, þe fela wundra wyrcaþ, swā swā hit wīde is cūþ, þǣm Ælmihtigan tō lofe, þe hīe on gelīefdon.
text_bare: Sind eac fela oþre on Angel-cynne halgan, þe fela wundra wyrcaþ, swa swa hit wide is cuþ, þæm Ælmihtigan to lofe, þe hie on geliefdon.

text: Crīst gesweotolaþ mannum þurh his mǣre hālgan þæt hē is ælmihtig God þe wyrcþ swelc wundru, þēah þe þā earman Iūdēiscan hine eallunga wiþsōcen, for þǣm þe hīe sind āwiergde, swā swā hīe wȳscton him selfum.
text_bare: Crist gesweotolaþ mannum þurh his mære halgan þæt he is ælmihtig God þe wyrcþ swelc wundru, þeah þe þa earman Iudeiscan hine eallunga wiþsocen, for þæm þe hie sind awiergde, swa swa hie wyscton him selfum.

text: Ne bēoþ nān wundru geworht æt hiera byrgennum, for þǣm þe hīe ne gelīefaþ on þone lifiendan Crīst; ac Crīst gesweotolaþ mannum hwǣr se gōda gelēafa is, þonne hē swelc wundru wyrcþ þurh his hālgan wīde geond þās eorþan, þæs him sīe wuldor and lof ā mid his heofonlicum Fæder and þǣm Hālgan Gāste, ā būtan ende.
text_bare: Ne beoþ nan wundru geworht æt hiera byrgennum, for þæm þe hie ne geliefaþ on þone lifiendan Crist; ac Crist gesweotolaþ mannum hwær se goda geleafa is, þonne he swelc wundru wyrcþ þurh his halgan wide geond þas eorþan, þæs him sie wuldor and lof a mid his heofonlicum Fæder and þæm Halgan Gaste, a butan ende.
